WITH eligible_rotations AS (
  SELECT
    cr.farmer_id,
    cr.crop_id,
    cr.year
  FROM crop_rotations AS cr
  JOIN crops AS c
    ON cr.crop_id = c.crop_id
  WHERE c.crop_type = 'grain'
),
year_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(year) AS min_year,
    MAX(year) AS max_year
  FROM eligible_rotations
),
revenue_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN re.estimation_date LIKE (SELECT min_year || '%'
                                          FROM year_bounds)
             THEN re.predicted_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_early_period,
    SUM(CASE WHEN re.estimation_date LIKE (SELECT max_year || '%'
                                          FROM year_bounds)
             THEN re.predicted_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_late_period
  FROM revenue_estimations AS re
  JOIN eligible_rotations AS er
    ON re.farmer_id = er.farmer_id
   AND re.crop_id = er.crop_id
)
SELECT
  revenue_late_period - revenue_early_period AS predicted_revenue_change
FROM revenue_by_period

WITH crop_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.crop_id,
    c.crop_name,
    COUNT(r.result_id) AS result_count,
    AVG(r.precipitation_yearTotal) AS avg_annual_precipitation,
    MAX(r.precipitation_yearTotal) AS max_annual_precipitation,
    AVG(s.pH) AS avg_soil_ph
  FROM crops AS c
  LEFT JOIN results AS r
    ON r.crop_id = c.crop_id
  LEFT JOIN soils AS s
    ON s.soil_id = r.soil_id
  GROUP BY c.crop_id, c.crop_name
)
SELECT
  crop_name,
  result_count,
  avg_annual_precipitation,
  max_annual_precipitation,
  avg_soil_ph,
  ROUND(1.0 * result_count / SUM(result_count) OVER (), 4) AS result_share_of_total
FROM crop_totals
WHERE result_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY result_share_of_total DESC, result_count DESC

measure: a change or difference between two periods
gold_sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    c.region AS region,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', ua.access_date) AS INTEGER) AS access_year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_accesses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.relationship_name = 'Husband' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS husband_accesses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.relationship_name = 'Husband' AND c.country_name = 'United-States' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS husband_us_accesses
  FROM user_access ua
  JOIN individuals i ON ua.individual_id = i.individual_id
  JOIN countries c ON i.native_country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN relationships r ON i.relationship_id = r.relationship_id
  WHERE ua.access_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.region, CAST(strftime('%Y', ua.access_date) AS INTEGER)
),
periods AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    access_year,
    total_accesses,
    husband_accesses,
    husband_us_accesses,
    ROUND(1.0 * husband_accesses / total_accesses, 4) AS husband_rate,
    ROUND(1.0 * husband_us_accesses / total_accesses, 4) AS husband_us_rate
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT
  region,
  access_year AS year,
  husband_rate - LAG(husband_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY access_year) AS husband_rate_change,
  husband_us_rate - LAG(husband_us_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY access_year) AS husband_us_rate_change
FROM periods
WHERE access_year IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY region, year

WITH review_stats AS (

    a.title AS article_title,

WITH flight_day_counts AS (
    SELECT
        f.flight_id,
        f.type_id,
        f.snapshot_date,
        COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_events,
        COUNT(DISTINCT al.user_id) AS distinct_users
    FROM flights AS f
    LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al
        ON al.flight_id = f.flight_id
    WHERE f.snapshot_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.type_id, f.snapshot_date
),
type_day_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        fdc.type_id,
        fdc.snapshot_date,
        SUM(fdc.access_events) AS total_access_events,
        SUM(fdc.distinct_users) AS total_distinct_users,
        COUNT(*) AS flights_on_day
    FROM flight_day_counts AS fdc
    GROUP BY fdc.type_id, fdc.snapshot_date
)
SELECT
    ft.type_name AS flight_type_name,
    tdr.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date,
    tdr.flights_on_day AS flights_on_day,
    tdr.total_access_events AS total_access_events,
    ROUND(1.0 * tdr.total_access_events / NULLIF(tdr.flights_on_day, 0), 2) AS access_events_per_flight_per_day,
    tdr.total_distinct_users AS total_distinct_users,
    ROUND(1.0 * tdr.total_distinct_users / NULLIF(tdr.flights_on_day, 0), 2) AS distinct_users_per_flight_per_day
FROM type_day_rollup AS tdr
JOIN flight_types AS ft
    ON ft.type_id = tdr.type_id
ORDER BY tdr.snapshot_date, ft.type_name

WITH airport_window AS (
  SELECT
    a.airport_id,
    a.name AS airport_name,
    a.city,
    a.country,
    COUNT(r.runway_id) AS runway_count,
    AVG(r.length_feet) AS avg_runway_length,
    MAX(r.length_feet) AS max_runway_length,
    COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count
  FROM airports AS a
  LEFT JOIN runways AS r
    ON r.airport_id = a.airport_id
  LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al
    ON al.airport_id = a.airport_id
  GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name, a.city, a.country
),
qualified_airports AS (
  SELECT
    airport_id,
    airport_name,
    city,
    country,
    runway_count,
    avg_runway_length,
    max_runway_length,
    access_count
  FROM airport_window
  WHERE runway_count >= 1
    AND avg_runway_length > 3000
),
ranked_airports AS (
  SELECT
    airport_id,
    airport_name,
    city,
    country,
    runway_count,
    avg_runway_length,
    max_runway_length,
    access_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY access_count DESC, avg_runway_length DESC, airport_id
    ) AS access_rank
  FROM qualified_airports
)
SELECT
  airport_id,
  airport_name,
  city,
  country,
  runway_count,
  avg_runway_length,
  max_runway_length,
  access_count,
  access_rank,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * access_count / SUM(access_count) OVER (),
    2
  ) AS access_share_pct
FROM ranked_airports
WHERE access_rank <= 10
ORDER BY access_rank, airport_id

WITH flight_span AS (
  SELECT
    f.flight_id,
    f.flight_number,
    f.airline_id,
    f.status,
    MIN(fs.departure_time) AS first_departure_time,
    MAX(fs.arrival_time) AS last_arrival_time,
    COUNT(fs.schedule_id) AS schedule_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fd.delay_duration IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delay_record_count,
    COUNT(fd.delay_id) AS total_delay_records,
    AVG(fd.delay_duration) AS avg_delay_duration
  FROM flights AS f
  LEFT JOIN flight_schedules AS fs
    ON f.flight_id = fs.flight_id
  LEFT JOIN flight_delays AS fd
    ON f.flight_id = fd.flight_id
  GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.flight_number, f.airline_id, f.status
),
delay_rate AS (
  SELECT
    flight_id,
    flight_number,
    airline_id,
    status,
    first_departure_time,
    last_arrival_time,
    schedule_count,
    delay_record_count,
    total_delay_records,
    avg_delay_duration,
    CASE
      WHEN schedule_count > 0 THEN 1.0 * delay_record_count / schedule_count
      ELSE NULL
    END AS delay_to_schedule_rate
  FROM flight_span
)
SELECT
  flight_id AS flight_id,
  flight_number AS flight_number,
  first_departure_time AS first_departure_time,
  last_arrival_time AS last_arrival_time,
  ROUND((julianday(last_arrival_time) - julianday(first_departure_time)) * 24 * 60, 2) AS span_minutes,
  schedule_count AS schedule_count,
  delay_record_count AS delay_record_count,
  total_delay_records AS total_delay_records,
  ROUND(avg_delay_duration, 2) AS avg_delay_duration,
  ROUND(delay_to_schedule_rate, 4) AS delay_to_schedule_rate
FROM delay_rate
WHERE first_departure_time IS NOT NULL
  AND last_arrival_time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY span_minutes DESC, flight_id
LIMIT 20

WITH filtered_measurements AS (
    SELECT
        apm.allele_id,
        apm.measurement_value,
        apm.measurement_type,
        apm.measurement_source_id,
        a.allele_name,
        a.class,
        ms.source_year
    FROM allele_peptide_measurements AS apm
    JOIN alleles AS a
        ON a.allele_id = apm.allele_id
    JOIN measurement_sources AS ms
        ON ms.source_id = apm.measurement_source_id

          FROM measurement_sources
          WHERE source_year IS NOT NULL

allele_source_ranked AS (

        allele_id,
        allele_name,
        class,
        source_year,
        COUNT(*) AS measurement_count,
        AVG(measurement_value) AS avg_measurement_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY allele_id
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, source_year DESC

),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        allele_id,
        allele_name,
        class,
        source_year,

WITH inventory_dedup AS (
  SELECT
    vehicle_id,
    dealership_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(stock_level, 0)) AS total_stock_level,
    SUM(COALESCE(reserved_units, 0)) AS total_reserved_units,
    SUM(COALESCE(available_units, 0)) AS total_available_units
  FROM vehicle_inventory
  GROUP BY vehicle_id, dealership_id

origin_vehicle AS (
  SELECT
    o.origin_id,
    o.origin_name,
    o.continent,
    v.vehicle_id,
    v.year
  FROM origins AS o
  JOIN vehicles AS v

),
origin_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    ov.origin_id,
    ov.origin_name,
    ov.continent,
    ov.vehicle_id,
    ov.year,
    SUM(COALESCE(id.total_stock_level, 0)) AS origin_stock_level,
    SUM(COALESCE(id.total_reserved_units, 0)) AS origin_reserved_units,
    SUM(COALESCE(id.total_available_units, 0)) AS origin_available_units
  FROM origin_vehicle AS ov
  LEFT JOIN inventory_dedup AS id
    ON id.vehicle_id = ov.vehicle_id
  GROUP BY ov.origin_id, ov.origin_name, ov.continent, ov.vehicle_id, ov.year

running_totals AS (

SELECT

  continent,
  vehicle_id,
  year,
  origin_stock_level,
  origin_reserved_units,
  origin_available_units,
  running_stock_level
FROM running_totals
ORDER BY continent, year, vehicle_id

WITH bio_stats AS (

    bs.description,

threshold_label AS (

WITH station_calibrations AS (
  SELECT
    i.station_id,
    s.station_name,
    s.location,
    i.instrumentation_id,
    i.instrument_type,
    i.instrument_model,
    i.manufacturer,
    COUNT(ic.calibration_id) AS total_calibrations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ic.calibration_method = 'factory calibration' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS factory_calibrations,
    AVG(ic.calibration_value) AS avg_calibration_value,
    AVG(ic.uncertainty) AS avg_uncertainty
  FROM instrumentation AS i
  JOIN stations AS s
    ON s.station_id = i.station_id
  LEFT JOIN instrumentation_calibration AS ic
    ON ic.instrumentation_id = i.instrumentation_id
  GROUP BY
    i.station_id,
    s.station_name,
    s.location,
    i.instrumentation_id,
    i.instrument_type,
    i.instrument_model,
    i.manufacturer
),
station_level AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    station_name,
    location,
    COUNT(instrumentation_id) AS instrumentation_count,
    SUM(total_calibrations) AS calibration_count,
    SUM(factory_calibrations) AS factory_calibration_count,
    AVG(avg_calibration_value) AS mean_calibration_value,
    AVG(avg_uncertainty) AS mean_uncertainty,
    1.0 * SUM(factory_calibrations) / COUNT(instrumentation_id) AS factory_per_instrument_ratio
  FROM station_calibrations
  GROUP BY
    station_id,
    station_name,
    location
)
SELECT
  station_id,
  station_name,
  location,
  instrumentation_count,
  calibration_count,
  factory_calibration_count,
  ROUND(factory_per_instrument_ratio, 3) AS factory_per_instrument_ratio,
  ROUND(mean_calibration_value, 3) AS mean_calibration_value,
  ROUND(mean_uncertainty, 3) AS mean_uncertainty,
  CASE
    WHEN factory_per_instrument_ratio >= 2.0 THEN 'high'
    WHEN factory_per_instrument_ratio >= 1.0 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS calibration_activity_label
FROM station_level
ORDER BY factory_per_instrument_ratio DESC, calibration_count DESC, station_id ASC

measure: a ratio or percentage with a carefully scoped denominator
gold_sql:
WITH analyzed_samples AS (
    SELECT
        sa.sample_id,
        sa.analysis_id,
        sa.analysis_type,
        sa.analysis_result,
        s.trial_id,
        s.sample_code,
        COUNT(sd.deviation_id) AS deviation_count,
        COUNT(sa.analysis_id) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.sample_id) AS analyses_per_sample
    FROM sample_analysis AS sa
    JOIN samples AS s
        ON s.sample_id = sa.sample_id
    LEFT JOIN sampling_deviation AS sd
        ON sd.sample_id = sa.sample_id
    GROUP BY
        sa.sample_id,
        sa.analysis_id,
        sa.analysis_type,
        sa.analysis_result,
        s.trial_id,
        s.sample_code
),
eligible_samples AS (
    SELECT
        sample_id,
        analysis_id,
        analysis_type,
        analysis_result,
        trial_id,
        sample_code,
        deviation_count,
        analyses_per_sample
    FROM analyzed_samples
    WHERE deviation_count >= 2
),
trial_level AS (
    SELECT
        trial_id,
        COUNT(*) AS eligible_analysis_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sample_id) AS eligible_samples,
        SUM(deviation_count) AS total_deviations,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analyses_per_sample >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_analyzed_rows
    FROM eligible_samples
    GROUP BY trial_id
),
ranked_trials AS (
    SELECT
        tl.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY tl.total_deviations DESC, tl.eligible_samples DESC, tl.trial_id
        ) AS trial_rank
    FROM trial_level AS tl
)
SELECT
    rt.trial_id AS trial_id,
    t.trial_name AS trial_name,
    rt.eligible_samples AS eligible_sample_count,
    rt.total_deviations AS total_deviation_count,
    rt.eligible_analysis_rows AS eligible_analysis_row_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * rt.multi_analyzed_rows / rt.eligible_analysis_rows, 2) AS multi_analyzed_row_percentage
FROM ranked_trials AS rt
JOIN trials AS t
    ON t.trial_id = rt.trial_id
WHERE rt.trial_rank <= 5
ORDER BY rt.trial_rank

WITH report_counts AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.user_name,
    COUNT(cr.report_id) AS total_reports,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cu.update_date IS NOT NULL THEN cr.report_id END) AS reports_with_any_update
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN case_reports cr
    ON u.user_id = cr.user_id
  LEFT JOIN case_updates cu
    ON cr.case_id = cu.case_id
  GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name
),
user_rates AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    user_name,
    total_reports,
    reports_with_any_update,
    1.0 * reports_with_any_update / NULLIF(total_reports, 0) AS update_coverage_rate
  FROM report_counts
)
SELECT
  AVG(update_coverage_rate) AS avg_update_coverage_rate
FROM user_rates

measure: a change or difference between two periods

WITH pub_access AS (
  SELECT
    p.publication_id,
    p.type_id,
    p.date,
    COUNT(al.access_id) AS access_count
  FROM publications p
  LEFT JOIN access_logs al
    ON p.publication_id = al.publication_id
  GROUP BY p.publication_id, p.type_id, p.date
),
type_periods AS (
  SELECT
    pt.type_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pa.date >= '2025-01-01' AND pa.date < '2026-01-01' THEN pa.access_count ELSE 0 END) AS accesses_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pa.date >= '2024-01-01' AND pa.date < '2025-01-01' THEN pa.access_count ELSE 0 END) AS accesses_2024
  FROM pub_access pa
  JOIN publication_types pt
    ON pa.type_id = pt.type_id
  GROUP BY pt.type_name
)
SELECT
  SUM(accesses_2025 - accesses_2024) AS access_change_2025_vs_2024
FROM type_periods
WHERE accesses_2025 > accesses_2024

WITH case_deaths AS (
  SELECT
    cc.region_id,
    cc.case_id,
    cc.confirmed,
    cc.deaths AS case_deaths,
    COUNT(dr.death_id) AS death_record_count
  FROM covid_cases cc
  LEFT JOIN death_records dr
    ON dr.case_id = cc.case_id
  GROUP BY
    cc.region_id,
    cc.case_id,
    cc.confirmed,
    cc.deaths
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT
    region_id,
    SUM(confirmed) AS total_confirmed_cases,
    SUM(case_deaths) AS total_case_deaths,
    SUM(death_record_count) AS total_death_records
  FROM case_deaths
  GROUP BY region_id
),
ranked_regions AS (
  SELECT
    rt.region_id,
    r.region_name,
    rt.total_confirmed_cases,
    rt.total_case_deaths,
    rt.total_death_records,
    SUM(rt.total_case_deaths) OVER () AS all_regions_case_deaths,
    ROUND(1.0 * rt.total_case_deaths / NULLIF(SUM(rt.total_case_deaths) OVER (), 0), 4) AS death_share_of_total,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rt.total_case_deaths DESC) AS death_rank
  FROM region_totals rt
  JOIN regions r
    ON r.region_id = rt.region_id
)
SELECT
  region_id,
  region_name,
  total_confirmed_cases,
  total_case_deaths,
  total_death_records,
  death_share_of_total,
  death_rank
FROM ranked_regions
ORDER BY total_case_deaths DESC, region_name

WITH opt_in_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS preference_rows,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cp.marketing_opt_in = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opt_in_rows
    FROM customers c
    JOIN customer_preferences cp
        ON cp.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN cp.marketing_opt_in = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
campaign_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ccm.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS campaign_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ccm.campaign_id) AS distinct_campaigns
    FROM campaign_customer_map ccm
    JOIN opt_in_customers o
        ON o.customer_id = ccm.customer_id
    GROUP BY ccm.customer_id
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.preference_rows,
        o.opt_in_rows,
        cc.campaign_rows,
        cc.distinct_campaigns,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY cc.distinct_campaigns DESC, cc.campaign_rows DESC, o.customer_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM opt_in_customers o
    JOIN campaign_counts cc
        ON cc.customer_id = o.customer_id
)
SELECT
    s.customer_id AS customer_id,
    s.preference_rows AS preference_rows,
    s.opt_in_rows AS opt_in_rows,
    s.campaign_rows AS campaign_rows,
    s.distinct_campaigns AS distinct_campaigns,
    1.0 * s.distinct_campaigns / SUM(s.distinct_campaigns) OVER () AS share_of_distinct_campaigns
FROM survivors s
WHERE s.rn <= 10
ORDER BY s.distinct_campaigns DESC, s.campaign_rows DESC, s.customer_id

gold_sql:
WITH selected_configs AS (
  SELECT
    hc.config_id,
    hc.config_name,
    COUNT(pm.metric_id) AS metric_count,
    AVG(CAST(REPLACE(pm.metric_value, 'ns', '') AS REAL)) AS avg_metric_value
  FROM hardware_configurations hc
  JOIN performance_metrics pm
    ON pm.config_id = hc.config_id
  JOIN memory_levels ml
    ON ml.memory_id = pm.memory_id
  WHERE ml.memory_level IN ('L1', 'L2', 'L3')
    AND pm.metric_value LIKE '%ns'
  GROUP BY hc.config_id, hc.config_name
  HAVING avg_metric_value IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_configs AS (
  SELECT
    config_id,
    config_name,
    metric_count,
    avg_metric_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_metric_value ASC) AS config_rank
  FROM selected_configs
  WHERE metric_count >= 5
),
final_summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS survivor_count,
    AVG(avg_metric_value) AS mean_avg_metric_value,
    MAX(avg_metric_value) AS max_avg_metric_value
  FROM ranked_configs
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN mean_avg_metric_value < 10 THEN 'low'
    WHEN mean_avg_metric_value < 50 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'high'

  e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name,
  COALESCE(oc.orders_processed, 0) AS orders_processed,
  COALESCE(sc.status_updates, 0) AS status_updates,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * COALESCE(oc.orders_processed, 0) / SUM(COALESCE(oc.orders_processed, 0)) OVER (),
    4
  ) AS share_of_all_processed_orders,
  ROUND(COALESCE(oc.avg_order_amount, 0), 2) AS avg_order_amount,
  ROUND(COALESCE(oc.max_order_amount, 0), 2) AS max_order_amount,

WITH product_groups AS (

    p.product_name,
    p.price,

    SELECT
      product_id,
      COUNT(*) AS reorder_count
    FROM reorder_history

  WHERE p.department_id IS NOT NULL

  FROM product_groups
)
SELECT
  active_period_value - inactive_period_value AS value_change_between_periods
FROM period_totals

WITH recent_employment AS (
  SELECT
    eh.personnel_id,
    COUNT(*) AS employment_count
  FROM employment_history eh
  WHERE eh.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday(eh.end_date) - julianday(eh.start_date) >= 365

ranked_evaluations AS (
  SELECT
    pe.personnel_id,
    pe.score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pe.personnel_id
      ORDER BY pe.evaluation_date

    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pe.personnel_id) AS eval_count

    ON re.personnel_id = pe.personnel_id
),
personnel_period_scores AS (
  SELECT
    personnel_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN eval_rank <= eval_count / 2 THEN score END) AS first_period_score,
    AVG(CASE WHEN eval_rank > eval_count / 2 THEN score END) AS second_period_score
  FROM ranked_evaluations
  GROUP BY personnel_id
)

  second_period_score - first_period_score AS score_change
FROM personnel_period_scores pps

  ON p.personnel_id = pps.personnel_id
WHERE first_period_score IS NOT NULL
  AND second_period_score IS NOT NULL

WITH eligible_devices AS (
  SELECT
    d.device_id,
    d.device_name,
    COUNT(cc.check_id) AS compliance_check_count,

    ON cc.device_id = d.device_id

WITH reminder_stats AS (
    SELECT
        er.event_id,
        COUNT(*) AS reminder_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN er.reminder_status = 'sent' THEN 1 END) AS sent_reminder_count,
        MIN(er.reminder_time) AS first_reminder_time,
        MAX(er.reminder_time) AS last_reminder_time
    FROM event_reminders er
    GROUP BY er.event_id
),
event_base AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.title,
        e.start_date,
        e.end_date,
        e.frequency_id,
        f.frequency_name,
        f.frequency_interval,
        COALESCE(rs.reminder_count, 0) AS reminder_count,
        COALESCE(rs.sent_reminder_count, 0) AS sent_reminder_count,
        rs.first_reminder_time,
        rs.last_reminder_time
    FROM events e
    LEFT JOIN frequencies f
        ON e.frequency_id = f.frequency_id
    LEFT JOIN reminder_stats rs
        ON e.event_id = rs.event_id
),
ordered_events AS (
    SELECT
        eb.*,
        CASE
            WHEN eb.frequency_name IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END AS has_frequency
    FROM event_base eb
)
SELECT
    event_id,
    title,
    start_date,
    frequency_name,
    reminder_count,
    sent_reminder_count,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * sent_reminder_count / NULLIF(reminder_count, 0),
        3
    ) AS sent_reminder_rate,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(sent_reminder_count) OVER (
            ORDER BY COALESCE(start_date, '9999-12-31'), event_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(reminder_count) OVER (
                ORDER BY COALESCE(start_date, '9999-12-31'), event_id
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ),
            0
        ),
        3
    ) AS cumulative_sent_reminder_rate
FROM ordered_events
ORDER BY COALESCE(start_date, '9999-12-31'), event_id

WITH metric_periods AS (
    SELECT
        source_id,
        COUNT(*) AS metric_count,
        AVG(metric_value) AS avg_metric_value,
        MIN(metric_value) AS min_metric_value,
        MAX(metric_value) AS max_metric_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN as_of_date < '2022-01-01' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS metric_sum_early,
        SUM(CASE WHEN as_of_date >= '2022-01-01' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS metric_sum_late
    FROM financial_metrics
    WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY source_id
),
ratio_periods AS (
    SELECT
        source_id,
        COUNT(*) AS ratio_count,
        AVG(ratio_value) AS avg_ratio_value,
        MIN(ratio_value) AS min_ratio_value,
        MAX(ratio_value) AS max_ratio_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN as_of_date < '2022-01-01' THEN ratio_value ELSE 0 END) AS ratio_sum_early,
        SUM(CASE WHEN as_of_date >= '2022-01-01' THEN ratio_value ELSE 0 END) AS ratio_sum_late
    FROM ratios
    WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY source_id
)
SELECT
    ds.source_id AS source_id,
    ds.source_name AS source_name,
    COALESCE(mp.metric_count, 0) AS metric_count,
    COALESCE(rp.ratio_count, 0) AS ratio_count,
    COALESCE(mp.avg_metric_value, 0) AS avg_metric_value,
    COALESCE(rp.avg_ratio_value, 0) AS avg_ratio_value,
    COALESCE(mp.max_metric_value, 0) AS max_metric_value,
    COALESCE(rp.max_ratio_value, 0) AS max_ratio_value,
    (COALESCE(mp.metric_sum_late, 0) - COALESCE(mp.metric_sum_early, 0)) AS metric_change_between_periods,
    (COALESCE(rp.ratio_sum_late, 0) - COALESCE(rp.ratio_sum_early, 0)) AS ratio_change_between_periods,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(mp.metric_sum_late, 0) - COALESCE(mp.metric_sum_early, 0) > 0 THEN 'increasing'
        WHEN COALESCE(mp.metric_sum_late, 0) - COALESCE(mp.metric_sum_early, 0) < 0 THEN 'decreasing'
        ELSE 'stable'
    END AS metric_change_label
FROM data_sources ds
LEFT JOIN metric_periods mp
    ON ds.source_id = mp.source_id
LEFT JOIN ratio_periods rp
    ON ds.source_id = rp.source_id
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(mp.metric_sum_late, 0) - COALESCE(mp.metric_sum_early, 0)) DESC, ds.source_id

WITH alert_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    AVG(alert_value) AS avg_alert_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN alert_triggered = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS triggered_alert_count
  FROM alerts
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
),
risk_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    AVG(max_loss_limit) AS avg_max_loss_limit,
    AVG(max_trade_size) AS avg_max_trade_size,
    AVG(max_position_size) AS avg_max_position_size,
    AVG(stop_loss_level) AS avg_stop_loss_level
  FROM risk_management
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
),
user_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.user_name,
    COALESCE(a.alert_count, 0) AS alert_count,
    COALESCE(a.avg_alert_value, 0) AS avg_alert_value,
    COALESCE(a.triggered_alert_count, 0) AS triggered_alert_count,
    COALESCE(r.avg_max_loss_limit, 0) AS avg_max_loss_limit,
    COALESCE(r.avg_max_trade_size, 0) AS avg_max_trade_size,
    COALESCE(r.avg_max_position_size, 0) AS avg_max_position_size,
    COALESCE(r.avg_stop_loss_level, 0) AS avg_stop_loss_level,
    (COALESCE(a.alert_count, 0) * COALESCE(a.avg_alert_value, 0)) + COALESCE(r.avg_max_loss_limit, 0) AS computed_risk_score
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN alert_rollup a
    ON u.user_id = a.user_id
  LEFT JOIN risk_rollup r
    ON u.user_id = r.user_id
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  user_name,
  alert_count,
  avg_alert_value,
  avg_max_loss_limit,
  avg_max_trade_size,
  avg_max_position_size,
  avg_stop_loss_level,
  computed_risk_score,
  CASE
    WHEN computed_risk_score >= 1000 THEN 'high'
    WHEN computed_risk_score >= 500 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS risk_label
FROM user_metrics
ORDER BY computed_risk_score DESC, user_id

WITH country_periods AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_id,
    c.country_name,
    il.income_level_name,
    r.region_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN g.year = 2018 THEN g.gni_value END) AS gni_2018,
    MAX(CASE WHEN g.year = 2023 THEN g.gni_value END) AS gni_2023
  FROM countries c
  JOIN income_levels il
    ON c.income_level = CAST(il.income_level_id AS TEXT)
  JOIN regions r
    ON c.region = CAST(r.region_id AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN gni g
    ON c.country_id = g.country_id
   AND g.year IN (2018, 2023)
  GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name, il.income_level_name, r.region_name
),
eligible_countries AS (
  SELECT
    country_id,
    country_name,
    income_level_name,
    region_name,
    (gni_2023 - gni_2018) AS gni_change
  FROM country_periods
  WHERE gni_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND gni_2023 IS NOT NULL
    AND gni_2023 > gni_2018
),
ranked_countries AS (
  SELECT
    country_name,
    income_level_name,
    region_name,
    gni_change,

GROUP BY income_level_name

WITH report_stats AS (
  SELECT
    pp.project_id,
    pp.procurement_mode,
    COUNT(pr.report_id) AS total_reports,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.report_status = 'generated' THEN 1 END) AS generated_reports
  FROM procurement_projects pp
  LEFT JOIN procurement_reports pr
    ON pr.project_id = pp.project_id
  GROUP BY pp.project_id, pp.procurement_mode
),
mode_summary AS (
  SELECT
    pm.mode_id,
    pm.mode_name,
    COUNT(rs.project_id) AS project_count,
    SUM(rs.total_reports) AS report_count,
    SUM(rs.generated_reports) AS generated_report_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.total_reports > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS projects_with_reports,
    1.0 * SUM(rs.generated_reports) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.total_reports), 0) AS generated_report_rate,
    1.0 * SUM(rs.generated_reports) / NULLIF(SUM(rs.total_reports) - SUM(CASE WHEN rs.project_id % 2 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS adjusted_generated_rate
  FROM procurement_modes pm
  LEFT JOIN report_stats rs
    ON rs.procurement_mode = pm.mode_id
  GROUP BY pm.mode_id, pm.mode_name
),
labeled_modes AS (
  SELECT
    mode_id,
    mode_name,
    project_count,
    report_count,
    generated_report_count,
    projects_with_reports,
    generated_report_rate,
    adjusted_generated_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN adjusted_generated_rate >= 0.75 THEN 'high'
      WHEN adjusted_generated_rate >= 0.40 THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'low'
    END AS rate_label
  FROM mode_summary
)
SELECT
  mode_id,
  mode_name,
  project_count,
  report_count,
  generated_report_count,
  projects_with_reports,
  generated_report_rate,
  adjusted_generated_rate,
  rate_label
FROM labeled_modes
ORDER BY adjusted_generated_rate DESC, report_count DESC, mode_name

WITH access_by_year AS (

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    i.individual_id,
    ag.age_group_name,
    st.smoking_name,
    i.age,
    i.smoker,
    (i.age * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(i.smoker, 0) + 1, 0)) AS age_smoking_ratio
  FROM individuals AS i
  JOIN age_groups AS ag
    ON i.age = ag.age_group_id
  JOIN smoking_types AS st
    ON i.smoker = st.smoking_id
  WHERE (i.age * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(i.smoker, 0) + 1, 0)) >= (
    SELECT AVG(i2.age * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(i2.smoker, 0) + 1, 0))

      AND i2.smoker IS NOT NULL
  )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    age_group_name,
    smoking_name,
    individual_id,
    age_smoking_ratio,

    ) AS rn
  FROM base
),
survivors AS (

WITH image_totals AS (
  SELECT
    it.type_name AS image_type_name,
    i.image_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(qm.contrast), 0) AS total_contrast
  FROM images AS i
  JOIN image_types AS it
    ON i.type_id = it.type_id
  LEFT JOIN quality_metrics AS qm
    ON qm.image_id = i.image_id
  GROUP BY it.type_name, i.image_id
),
running_totals AS (
  SELECT
    image_type_name,
    image_id,
    total_contrast,
    SUM(total_contrast) OVER (
      ORDER BY image_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_contrast_total
  FROM image_totals
)
SELECT
  image_type_name,
  image_id,
  total_contrast,
  running_contrast_total,
  ROUND(
    running_contrast_total * 1.0 /
    (SELECT SUM(total_contrast) FROM image_totals WHERE image_type_name <> 'medical images'),
    4
  ) AS running_contrast_share_excluding_medical_images
FROM running_totals
ORDER BY image_id

WITH high_value_points AS (
    SELECT
        dp.data_point_id,
        dp.indicator_id,
        dp.year,
        dp.value,
        dp.source_id,
        ei.country_id
    FROM data_points AS dp
    JOIN economic_indicators AS ei
        ON dp.indicator_id = ei.indicator_id
    JOIN data_sources AS ds
        ON dp.source_id = ds.source_id
    WHERE dp.value IS NOT NULL
      AND dp.year IS NOT NULL
      AND ei.year IS NOT NULL
      AND dp.value > (
          SELECT AVG(value)
          FROM data_points
          WHERE value IS NOT NULL
      )
      AND ds.update_frequency IN (
          SELECT update_frequency
          FROM data_sources
          WHERE update_frequency IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY update_frequency
          HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
      )
),
country_event_counts AS (
    SELECT
        country_id,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT source_id) AS source_count,
        AVG(value) AS avg_event_value,
        MAX(year) AS latest_event_year
    FROM high_value_points
    GROUP BY country_id
),
ranked_countries AS (
    SELECT
        country_id,
        event_count,
        source_count,
        avg_event_value,
        latest_event_year,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY event_count DESC, avg_event_value DESC) AS event_rank
    FROM country_event_counts
)
SELECT
    c.country_name AS country_name,
    rc.country_id AS country_id,
    rc.event_count AS event_count,
    rc.source_count AS source_count,
    rc.avg_event_value AS avg_event_value,
    rc.latest_event_year AS latest_event_year,
    rc.event_rank AS event_rank
FROM ranked_countries AS rc
JOIN countries AS c
    ON c.country_id = rc.country_id
WHERE rc.event_rank <= 10
ORDER BY rc.event_count DESC, rc.avg_event_value DESC, c.country_name

WITH indicator_scope AS (

scored AS (

      PARTITION BY indicator_type_id, methodology_id

    MAX(indicator_value) OVER (
      PARTITION BY indicator_type_id, methodology_id

    MIN(indicator_value) OVER (

labeled_sets AS (

                WHEN rl.log_time >= er.end_time THEN 1
                ELSE 0

SELECT

  art.artist_name AS artist_name,
  a.release_year AS release_year,
  SUM(s.sales_volume) AS yearly_sales_volume,
  SUM(SUM(s.sales_volume)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY a.artist_id
    ORDER BY a.release_year
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_sales_volume
FROM albums AS a
JOIN sales_by_country AS s
  ON s.album_id = a.album_id
JOIN artists AS art
  ON art.artist_id = a.artist_id
WHERE a.release_year = (
  SELECT MIN(a2.release_year)
  FROM albums AS a2
  WHERE a2.artist_id = a.artist_id
)
GROUP BY a.artist_id, art.artist_name, a.release_year
ORDER BY running_sales_volume DESC, a.artist_id

museum_event_summary AS (

    AVG(julianday(event_date)) AS avg_event_date_jd,

  earliest_event_date,

  cumulative_event_total

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY es.museum_id

)

WITH track_span AS (

    a.release_date AS album_release_date,
    MIN(lh.listen_date) AS first_listen_date,
    MAX(lh.listen_date) AS last_listen_date,

    COUNT(DISTINCT lh.user_id) AS distinct_listener_count,
    AVG(lh.listen_count) AS avg_listen_count

    ON a.album_id = t.album_id

  album_release_date,
  first_listen_date,
  last_listen_date,
  julianday(last_listen_date) - julianday(first_listen_date) AS listen_span_days,
  listen_event_count,
  distinct_listener_count,
  CASE

    ELSE NULL
  END AS listener_to_event_ratio,
  avg_listen_count,
  CASE
    WHEN listen_event_count > 0 THEN 'has_listening_history'
    ELSE 'no_listening_history'

FROM track_span

WITH player_team AS (

  FROM players p

ranked_teams AS (

  FROM player_team

WITH user_daily AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id AS user_id,
    u.username AS username,
    DATE(ph.play_time) AS activity_date,
    COUNT(ph.history_id) AS plays_on_date
  FROM user_profiles AS u

    ON ph.user_id = u.user_id

),
daily_running AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    username,
    activity_date,
    plays_on_date,
    SUM(COALESCE(plays_on_date, 0)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY user_id
      ORDER BY activity_date

    ) AS running_play_total
  FROM user_daily
),
latest_running AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    username,
    MAX(activity_date) AS latest_activity_date,
    MAX(running_play_total) AS cumulative_play_total
  FROM daily_running

WITH sc_year AS (
  SELECT
    fd.sub_category_id,
    fd.year,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_count,
    AVG(fd.predicted_sales) AS avg_predicted_sales,
    MAX(fd.predicted_sales) AS max_predicted_sales,
    MIN(fd.predicted_sales) AS min_predicted_sales
  FROM forecast_data AS fd
  WHERE fd.sub_category_id IS NOT NULL
    AND fd.year IS NOT NULL
    AND fd.predicted_sales IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fd.sub_category_id, fd.year
),
subcat_totals AS (
  SELECT
    sub_category_id,
    SUM(forecast_count) AS total_forecasts,
    SUM(avg_predicted_sales * forecast_count) AS weighted_sales_sum
  FROM sc_year
  GROUP BY sub_category_id
),
year_totals AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    SUM(forecast_count) AS forecasts_in_year
  FROM sc_year
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
  sc.sub_category_name AS sub_category_name,
  y.year_description AS year_description,
  sy.forecast_count AS forecast_count,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * sy.forecast_count / NULLIF(st.total_forecasts, 0),
    2
  ) AS forecast_share_pct,
  ROUND(sy.avg_predicted_sales, 2) AS avg_predicted_sales,
  sy.max_predicted_sales AS max_predicted_sales,
  CASE
    WHEN sy.max_predicted_sales = sy.min_predicted_sales THEN 'flat'
    WHEN sy.max_predicted_sales > sy.avg_predicted_sales THEN 'above_average_peak'
    ELSE 'below_average_peak'
  END AS sales_pattern_label
FROM sc_year AS sy
JOIN sub_categories AS sc
  ON sc.sub_category_id = sy.sub_category_id
JOIN years AS y
  ON y.year = sy.year
JOIN subcat_totals AS st
  ON st.sub_category_id = sy.sub_category_id
JOIN year_totals AS yt
  ON yt.year = sy.year
ORDER BY forecast_share_pct DESC, avg_predicted_sales DESC, sub_category_name, year_description

WITH bill_spans AS (
  SELECT
    b.bill_id,
    b.user_id,
    b.category_id,
    b.scheduled_date,
    b.due_date,
    b.status,
    (julianday(b.due_date) - julianday(b.scheduled_date)) * 86400.0 AS schedule_to_due_seconds
  FROM bills AS b
  WHERE b.scheduled_date IS NOT NULL
    AND b.due_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  u.user_id AS user_id,
  u.username AS username,
  c.category_name AS category_name,
  AVG(bs.schedule_to_due_seconds) AS avg_schedule_to_due_seconds,
  COUNT(bs.bill_id) AS bill_count,
  COUNT(bc.bill_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(bs.bill_id) AS primary_category_bill_ratio
FROM bill_spans AS bs
JOIN users AS u
  ON u.user_id = bs.user_id
JOIN categories AS c
  ON c.category_id = bs.category_id
LEFT JOIN bill_categories AS bc
  ON bc.bill_id = bs.bill_id
 AND bc.category_id = bs.category_id
 AND bc.primary_category = 1
WHERE bs.status IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, c.category_name
HAVING COUNT(bs.bill_id) > 0
ORDER BY avg_schedule_to_due_seconds DESC

WITH facility_scope AS (
  SELECT
    f.facility_id,
    f.park_id,
    f.facility_type
  FROM facilities AS f
),
request_counts AS (
  SELECT
    fs.facility_id,
    fs.park_id,
    fs.facility_type,
    COUNT(mr.request_id) AS total_requests,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mr.request_status = 'open' THEN 1 END) AS open_requests
  FROM facility_scope AS fs
  LEFT JOIN maintenance_requests AS mr
    ON mr.facility_id = fs.facility_id
  GROUP BY
    fs.facility_id,
    fs.park_id,
    fs.facility_type
),
type_totals AS (
  SELECT
    facility_type,
    SUM(total_requests) AS type_total_requests
  FROM request_counts

)
SELECT
  rc.facility_type AS facility_type,
  COUNT(*) AS facility_count,
  SUM(rc.total_requests) AS total_requests,
  SUM(rc.open_requests) AS open_requests,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * SUM(rc.total_requests) / SUM(SUM(rc.total_requests)) OVER (),
    4
  ) AS request_share_of_all_requests,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * SUM(rc.total_requests) / NULLIF(tt.type_total_requests, 0),

FROM request_counts AS rc

  ON (rc.facility_type = tt.facility_type OR (rc.facility_type IS NULL AND tt.facility_type IS NULL))
GROUP BY

WITH session_episode_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ts.session_id,
        ts.agent_id,
        ts.environment_id,
        COUNT(tem.episode_id) AS episode_count,
        AVG(tem.reward) AS avg_episode_reward,
        AVG(tem.teaching_time) AS avg_episode_teaching_time,
        AVG(tem.attention_focus) AS avg_episode_attention_focus
    FROM training_sessions ts
    LEFT JOIN training_episode_metrics tem
        ON ts.session_id = tem.session_id
    GROUP BY
        ts.session_id,
        ts.agent_id,
        ts.environment_id
),
session_annotation_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ts.session_id,
        COUNT(a.annotation_id) AS annotation_count,
        AVG(LENGTH(a.annotation_text)) AS avg_annotation_length
    FROM training_sessions ts
    LEFT JOIN annotations a
        ON ts.session_id = a.session_id
    GROUP BY ts.session_id
)
SELECT
    e.environment_name AS environment_name,
    COUNT(*) AS session_count,
    AVG(ses.avg_episode_reward) AS avg_session_episode_reward,
    AVG(sas.avg_annotation_length) AS avg_annotation_length,
    AVG(
        CASE
            WHEN ses.episode_count > 0 THEN CAST(sas.annotation_count AS REAL) / ses.episode_count
            ELSE NULL
        END
    ) AS avg_annotations_per_episode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ses.episode_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_without_episodes
FROM session_episode_stats ses
JOIN session_annotation_stats sas
    ON ses.session_id = sas.session_id
JOIN training_sessions ts
    ON ses.session_id = ts.session_id
JOIN environments e
    ON ts.environment_id = e.environment_id
GROUP BY e.environment_name
ORDER BY avg_annotations_per_episode DESC, environment_name

project_metrics AS (

  FROM projects p

  project_name,
  bug_count,
  ROUND(avg_attachments_per_bug, 2) AS avg_attachments_per_bug,
  largest_attachment_size,

    WHEN attachment_density >= 1 THEN 'medium_attachment_project'
    ELSE 'low_attachment_project'
  END AS attachment_profile
FROM project_metrics

WITH tissue_cell_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.tissue,
    COUNT(*) AS cell_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.cell_ontology_class) AS distinct_cell_classes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.cell_ontology_id) AS distinct_cell_ontology_ids
  FROM cells AS c
  WHERE c.tissue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.tissue
),
tissue_class_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.tissue,
    c.cell_ontology_class,
    COUNT(*) AS class_cell_count
  FROM cells AS c
  WHERE c.tissue IS NOT NULL
    AND c.cell_ontology_class IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.tissue, c.cell_ontology_class
),
ranked_tissue_classes AS (
  SELECT
    tcc.tissue,
    tcc.cell_ontology_class,
    tcc.class_cell_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY tcc.tissue
      ORDER BY tcc.class_cell_count DESC, tcc.cell_ontology_class
    ) AS class_rank
  FROM tissue_class_counts AS tcc
),
ordered_tissues AS (
  SELECT
    t.tissue_id,
    t.tissue_name,
    t.description,
    tcc.cell_count,
    tcc.distinct_cell_classes,
    tcc.distinct_cell_ontology_ids,
    rtc.cell_ontology_class AS top_cell_ontology_class,
    rtc.class_cell_count AS top_cell_ontology_class_count,
    COALESCE(tcc.cell_count, 0) AS order_cell_count
  FROM tissues AS t
  LEFT JOIN tissue_cell_counts AS tcc
    ON t.tissue_id = tcc.tissue
  LEFT JOIN ranked_tissue_classes AS rtc
    ON t.tissue_id = rtc.tissue
   AND rtc.class_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  tissue_id,
  tissue_name,
  description,
  cell_count,
  distinct_cell_classes,
  distinct_cell_ontology_ids,
  top_cell_ontology_class,
  top_cell_ontology_class_count,
  SUM(order_cell_count) OVER (
    ORDER BY order_cell_count DESC, tissue_name
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_cell_count
FROM ordered_tissues
ORDER BY order_cell_count DESC, tissue_name

naive_sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(c.commit_id)
   FROM commits AS c
   WHERE c.commit_date >= '2024-01-01') -
  (SELECT COUNT(c.commit_id)
   FROM commits AS c
   WHERE c.commit_date < '2024-01-01') AS commit_count_change,
  (SELECT COUNT(i.issue_id)
   FROM commits AS c
   JOIN issues AS i
     ON i.commit_id = c.commit_id
   WHERE c.commit_date >= '2024-01-01') -
  (SELECT COUNT(i.issue_id)
   FROM commits AS c
   JOIN issues AS i
     ON i.commit_id = c.commit_id
   WHERE c.commit_date < '2024-01-01') AS issue_count_change
gold_sql:
WITH issue_periods AS (
  SELECT
    c.commit_id AS commit_id,
    CASE
      WHEN c.commit_date < '2024-01-01' THEN 'prior_period'
      ELSE 'current_period'
    END AS period_name,
    COUNT(i.issue_id) AS issue_count
  FROM commits AS c
  LEFT JOIN issues AS i
    ON i.commit_id = c.commit_id
  GROUP BY c.commit_id, period_name
),
commit_period_totals AS (
  SELECT
    period_name,
    COUNT(commit_id) AS commit_count,
    SUM(issue_count) AS total_issue_count
  FROM issue_periods
  GROUP BY period_name
)
SELECT
  current_period.commit_count - prior_period.commit_count AS commit_count_change,
  current_period.total_issue_count - prior_period.total_issue_count AS issue_count_change
FROM
  (SELECT commit_count, total_issue_count FROM commit_period_totals WHERE period_name = 'current_period') AS current_period
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT commit_count, total_issue_count FROM commit_period_totals WHERE period_name = 'prior_period') AS prior_period

WITH accessed_releases AS (
    SELECT
        r.release_id,
        r.product_id,
        r.release_date,
        r.version_number,
        r.update_number,
        r.file_size,
        sp.product_name,
        sp.category,
        COUNT(ua.access_id) AS access_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ua.user_id) AS distinct_user_count,
        MIN(ua.access_date) AS first_access_date,
        MAX(ua.access_date) AS last_access_date
    FROM releases AS r
    JOIN software_products AS sp
        ON sp.product_id = r.product_id
    JOIN user_access AS ua
        ON ua.release_id = r.release_id
    WHERE sp.status = 'active'
    GROUP BY
        r.release_id,
        r.product_id,
        r.release_date,
        r.version_number,
        r.update_number,
        r.file_size,
        sp.product_name,
        sp.category
),
ranked_releases AS (
    SELECT
        ar.*,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ar.product_id
            ORDER BY ar.access_count DESC, ar.last_access_date DESC
        ) AS access_rank
    FROM accessed_releases AS ar
    WHERE julianday(ar.last_access_date) - julianday(ar.first_access_date) >= 7
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        rr.*,
        julianday(rr.last_access_date) - julianday(rr.first_access_date) AS access_span_days
    FROM ranked_releases AS rr
    WHERE rr.access_rank <= 3
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS surviving_release_count,
    SUM(access_count) AS total_access_count,
    MIN(first_access_date) AS earliest_access_date,
    MAX(last_access_date) AS latest_access_date,
    AVG(access_span_days) AS avg_access_span_days
FROM survivors
GROUP BY
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category
ORDER BY
    total_access_count DESC,
    product_name ASC

WITH assignment_stats AS (

    COUNT(*) AS assignment_count,

  GROUP BY ta.user_id
),
report_stats AS (
  SELECT
    r.report_generated_by_user_id AS user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS report_count,
    AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(r.report_type, ''))) AS avg_report_type_length,
    MAX(r.report_date) AS latest_report_date
  FROM reports AS r
  GROUP BY r.report_generated_by_user_id
),
user_measures AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.user_name,
    COALESCE(a.assignment_count, 0) AS assignment_count,
    COALESCE(a.avg_status_length, 0) AS avg_status_length,
    COALESCE(a.completed_assignment_ratio, 0) AS completed_assignment_ratio,
    COALESCE(a.latest_due_date, '') AS latest_due_date,
    COALESCE(r.report_count, 0) AS report_count,
    COALESCE(r.avg_report_type_length, 0) AS avg_report_type_length,
    COALESCE(r.latest_report_date, '') AS latest_report_date,
    COALESCE(r.report_count, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(a.assignment_count, 0), 0) AS report_to_assignment_ratio
  FROM users AS u
  LEFT JOIN assignment_stats AS a
    ON u.user_id = a.user_id
  LEFT JOIN report_stats AS r
    ON u.user_id = r.user_id
),
ranked_users AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

  avg_status_length,

  completed_assignment_ratio,
  latest_due_date,
  latest_report_date,
  rank_by_assignment_count AS headline_max_assignment_row
FROM ranked_users

WITH team_periods AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_id,
    t.team_name,
    t.division,
    d.division_name,
    f.engagement_date,
    f.engagement_type,
    f.engagement_duration,
    CASE
      WHEN f.engagement_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' THEN 'h1'
      WHEN f.engagement_date BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-12-31' THEN 'h2'
    END AS period_label
  FROM teams AS t
  JOIN divisions AS d
    ON t.division = d.division_id
  LEFT JOIN fan_engagement AS f
    ON f.team_id = t.team_id
  WHERE f.engagement_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    team_id,
    team_name,
    division_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_engagements,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'h1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_engagements,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'h2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_engagements,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'h1' THEN engagement_duration ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_duration,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'h2' THEN engagement_duration ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_duration,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'h1' AND engagement_type <> 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_non_view_engagements,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'h2' AND engagement_type <> 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_non_view_engagements
  FROM team_periods
  GROUP BY team_id, team_name, division_name
)
SELECT
  team_name,
  division_name,
  total_engagements,
  ROUND(1.0 * first_half_non_view_engagements / first_half_engagements, 4) AS first_half_non_view_rate,
  ROUND(1.0 * second_half_non_view_engagements / second_half_engagements, 4) AS second_half_non_view_rate,
  ROUND(
    (1.0 * second_half_non_view_engagements / second_half_engagements)
    - (1.0 * first_half_non_view_engagements / first_half_engagements),
    4
  ) AS non_view_rate_change,
  ROUND(1.0 * second_half_duration / second_half_engagements, 2) AS second_half_avg_duration
FROM agg
WHERE first_half_engagements > 0
  AND second_half_engagements > 0
ORDER BY non_view_rate_change DESC, total_engagements DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH team_game_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.team_id AS team_id,
        t.team_name AS team_name,
        s.season AS season,
        COUNT(*) AS games_played,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN g.home_team_id = t.team_id THEN (g.home_team_score - g.away_team_score)
                ELSE (g.away_team_score - g.home_team_score)
            END
        ) AS avg_point_differential_per_game,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN g.home_team_id = t.team_id THEN g.home_team_score
                ELSE g.away_team_score
            END
        ) AS avg_points_scored_per_game,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN g.home_team_id = t.team_id THEN g.away_team_score
                ELSE g.home_team_score
            END
        ) AS avg_points_allowed_per_game
    FROM teams AS t
    JOIN games AS g
        ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
        OR g.away_team_id = t.team_id
    JOIN standings AS s
        ON s.team_id = t.team_id
       AND s.season = g.season
    GROUP BY
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        s.season
),
season_summary AS (
    SELECT
        season AS season,
        COUNT(*) AS team_season_rows,
        AVG(avg_point_differential_per_game) AS league_avg_point_differential_per_game,
        AVG(avg_points_scored_per_game) AS league_avg_points_scored_per_game,
        AVG(avg_points_allowed_per_game) AS league_avg_points_allowed_per_game,
        AVG(games_played) AS avg_games_played_per_team
    FROM team_game_stats
    GROUP BY season
)
SELECT
    season AS season,
    team_season_rows AS team_season_rows,
    league_avg_point_differential_per_game AS league_avg_point_differential_per_game,
    league_avg_points_scored_per_game AS league_avg_points_scored_per_game,
    league_avg_points_allowed_per_game AS league_avg_points_allowed_per_game,
    avg_games_played_per_team AS avg_games_played_per_team
FROM season_summary
ORDER BY season

WITH city_startup_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.city_id,
    c.city_name,
    c.country,
    c.region,
    COUNT(s.startup_id) AS startup_count,
    AVG(s.employee_count) AS avg_employee_count,
    AVG(s.revenue_annual) AS avg_revenue_annual
  FROM cities c
  JOIN startups s
    ON s.city_id = c.city_id
  GROUP BY
    c.city_id,
    c.city_name,
    c.country,
    c.region
),
ranked_cities AS (
  SELECT
    css.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY css.startup_count DESC, css.avg_revenue_annual DESC
    ) AS city_rank
  FROM city_startup_stats css
  WHERE css.startup_count >= (
    SELECT AVG(startup_count)
    FROM city_startup_stats
  )
),
top_city_verticals AS (
  SELECT
    rc.city_id,
    rc.city_name,
    rc.country,

    rc.avg_revenue_annual,

  JOIN startups s
    ON s.city_id = rc.city_id
  JOIN sub_verticals sv
    ON sv.sub_vertical_id = s.sub_vertical_id
  WHERE rc.city_rank = 1
  GROUP BY
    rc.city_id,
    rc.city_name,
    rc.country,
    rc.region,
    rc.startup_count,
    rc.avg_employee_count,
    rc.avg_revenue_annual,
    sv.sub_vertical_id,

)
SELECT
  city_name,
  country,
  region,
  startup_count,
  avg_employee_count,
  avg_revenue_annual,
  sub_vertical_name,
  startup_count_in_vertical,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * startup_count_in_vertical / SUM(startup_count_in_vertical) OVER (),

WITH period_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.dataset_id,
    d.dataset_name,
    COUNT(p.permission_id) AS permission_count,
    COUNT(r.report_id) AS report_count,
    AVG(r.viewer_count) AS avg_report_views,
    MAX(r.viewer_count) AS max_report_views,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.report_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_reports,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.report_date < '2024-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS older_reports
  FROM datasets d
  LEFT JOIN permissions p
    ON p.dataset_id = d.dataset_id
  LEFT JOIN reports r
    ON r.dataset_id = d.dataset_id
  GROUP BY d.dataset_id, d.dataset_name
)
SELECT
  dataset_id,
  dataset_name,
  permission_count,
  report_count,
  avg_report_views,
  max_report_views,
  recent_reports - older_reports AS report_change_between_periods,
  CASE
    WHEN report_count > 0 THEN 1.0 * permission_count / report_count
    ELSE NULL
  END AS permissions_per_report_ratio
FROM period_stats
ORDER BY report_change_between_periods DESC, report_count DESC

WITH course_perf AS (
  SELECT
    p.professor_id,
    p.name AS professor_name,
    p.department,
    e.enrollment_id,
    e.enrolled,
    e.avg_grade,
    e.std_dev
  FROM professors p
  JOIN enrollment e
    ON p.professor_id = e.professor_id
),
prof_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    professor_id,
    professor_name,
    department,
    COUNT(*) AS course_count,
    AVG(avg_grade) AS avg_course_avg_grade,
    AVG(enrolled * 1.0 / NULLIF(std_dev, 0)) AS avg_enrollment_stddev_ratio,
    MAX(enrolled) AS max_enrolled,
    SUM(CASE WHEN avg_grade >= 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_grade_course_count
  FROM course_perf
  GROUP BY professor_id, professor_name, department
)
SELECT
  professor_id,
  professor_name,
  department,
  course_count,
  avg_course_avg_grade,
  avg_enrollment_stddev_ratio,
  max_enrolled,
  high_grade_course_count,
  CASE
    WHEN avg_course_avg_grade >= 75 THEN 'high'
    WHEN avg_course_avg_grade >= 60 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS performance_label
FROM prof_metrics
ORDER BY avg_course_avg_grade DESC, course_count DESC

WITH eligible_servers AS (
    SELECT
        sc.server_id,
        COUNT(*) AS call_count
    FROM system_calls sc
    JOIN servers s
        ON s.server_id = sc.server_id
    WHERE sc.execution_time > (
        SELECT AVG(sc2.execution_time)
        FROM system_calls sc2
        WHERE sc2.server_id = sc.server_id
          AND sc2.execution_time IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY sc.server_id
),
ranked_servers AS (
    SELECT
        es.server_id,
        es.call_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY es.call_count DESC, es.server_id) AS call_rank
    FROM eligible_servers es
)
SELECT
    s.server_name AS server_name,
    ct.category AS call_category,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT date(sc.timestamp)), 2) AS calls_per_day
FROM ranked_servers rs
JOIN system_calls sc
    ON sc.server_id = rs.server_id
JOIN servers s
    ON s.server_id = rs.server_id
LEFT JOIN call_types ct
    ON ct.type_name = sc.call_type
WHERE rs.call_rank <= 5
GROUP BY s.server_name, ct.category
ORDER BY calls_per_day DESC, server_name, call_category

naive_sql:
SELECT
  g.group_id AS group_id,
  g.group_name AS group_name,
  COUNT(sn.note_id) AS note_count,
  AVG((julianday(cs.end_time) - julianday(cs.start_time)) * 24.0 * 60.0) AS avg_session_duration_minutes
FROM groups AS g
JOIN collaborative_sessions AS cs
  ON cs.group_id = g.group_id
JOIN session_notes AS sn
  ON sn.session_id = cs.session_id
WHERE cs.start_time IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.end_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY g.group_id, g.group_name
ORDER BY g.group_id
gold_sql:
WITH session_span AS (
  SELECT
    cs.session_id,
    cs.group_id,
    cs.task_id,
    (julianday(cs.end_time) - julianday(cs.start_time)) * 24.0 * 60.0 AS session_duration_minutes
  FROM collaborative_sessions AS cs
  WHERE cs.start_time IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
group_session_notes AS (
  SELECT
    ss.group_id,
    COUNT(sn.note_id) AS note_count,
    AVG(ss.session_duration_minutes) AS avg_session_duration_minutes
  FROM session_span AS ss
  LEFT JOIN session_notes AS sn
    ON sn.session_id = ss.session_id
  GROUP BY ss.group_id
)
SELECT
  g.group_id AS group_id,
  g.group_name AS group_name,
  COALESCE(gsn.note_count, 0) AS note_count,
  gsn.avg_session_duration_minutes AS avg_session_duration_minutes
FROM groups AS g
LEFT JOIN group_session_notes AS gsn
  ON gsn.group_id = g.group_id
ORDER BY g.group_id

measure: a running or cumulative total over an ordering
gold_sql:
WITH county_year_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.county_id,
    c.county_name,
    y.year_name,
    ed.data_id,
    ed."index" AS economic_index,
    COUNT(ed.data_id) OVER (PARTITION BY c.county_id) AS data_points_per_county,
    AVG(ed."index") OVER (PARTITION BY c.county_id) AS avg_index_per_county,
    MAX(ed."index") OVER (PARTITION BY c.county_id) AS max_index_per_county,
    MIN(ed."index") OVER (PARTITION BY c.county_id) AS min_index_per_county,
    CASE
      WHEN ed."index" >= AVG(ed."index") OVER (PARTITION BY c.county_id) THEN 'above_average'
      ELSE 'below_average'
    END AS index_label,
    SUM(ed."index") OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.county_id
      ORDER BY y.year_name
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_index_total
  FROM economic_data ed
  JOIN counties c ON c.county_id = ed.county_id
  JOIN years y ON y.year_id = ed.year
)
SELECT
  county_id,
  county_name,
  year_name,
  data_points_per_county AS count_measure,
  avg_index_per_county AS average_measure,
  max_index_per_county AS extreme_measure,
  index_label AS label_measure,
  running_index_total AS cumulative_total_measure
FROM county_year_stats
ORDER BY county_id, year_name

WITH cancer_by_state AS (
  SELECT
    primary_state_name AS state_name,
    cancer,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    AVG(age_adjusted_rate) AS avg_age_adjusted_rate,
    AVG(survival_time) AS avg_survival_time
  FROM cancer_cases
  WHERE primary_state_name IS NOT NULL
    AND cancer IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY primary_state_name, cancer
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT
    state_name,
    SUM(event_count) AS total_events
  FROM cancer_by_state
  GROUP BY state_name
),
top_cancers AS (
  SELECT
    c.state_name,
    c.cancer,
    c.event_count,
    c.avg_age_adjusted_rate,
    c.avg_survival_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.state_name
      ORDER BY c.event_count DESC, c.cancer
    ) AS rn
  FROM cancer_by_state c
  JOIN state_totals s
    ON c.state_name = s.state_name
  WHERE s.total_events >= 50
)
SELECT
  state_name,
  cancer AS top_cancer,
  event_count AS cancer_event_count,
  avg_age_adjusted_rate,
  avg_survival_time
FROM top_cancers
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY cancer_event_count DESC, state_name

WITH role_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ura.user_id AS user_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ura.role_id) AS role_count
  FROM user_role_assignments AS ura
  GROUP BY ura.user_id
),
role_labels AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    role_count,
    CASE
      WHEN role_count >= 3 THEN 'high'
      WHEN role_count = 2 THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'low'
    END AS role_label
  FROM role_counts
)
SELECT
  u.user_id AS user_id,
  u.first_name AS first_name,
  u.last_name AS last_name,
  rl.role_count AS role_count,
  rl.role_label AS role_label
FROM users AS u
JOIN role_labels AS rl
  ON u.user_id = rl.user_id
JOIN user_role_assignments AS ura
  ON u.user_id = ura.user_id
JOIN user_roles AS ur
  ON ura.role_id = ur.role_id
GROUP BY
  u.user_id,
  u.first_name,
  u.last_name,
  rl.role_count,
  rl.role_label
ORDER BY rl.role_count DESC, u.user_id

SELECT

  COUNT(*) AS ranking_count,
  ROUND(SUM(c.cpf_score + e.er_score) / COUNT(*), 2) AS combined_score_per_ranking
FROM universities AS u
JOIN rankings AS r
  ON r.university_id = u.university_id
JOIN citations_per_faculty AS c
  ON c.ranking_id = r.ranking_id
JOIN employer_reputation AS e

gold_sql:
WITH metric_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.university_id,
    r.ranking_id,
    r.year,
    r.rank,
    COALESCE(c.cpf_score, 0) + COALESCE(e.er_score, 0) AS combined_score,
    COALESCE(c.cpf_score, 0) AS cpf_score,
    COALESCE(e.er_score, 0) AS er_score
  FROM rankings AS r
  LEFT JOIN citations_per_faculty AS c
    ON c.ranking_id = r.ranking_id
  LEFT JOIN employer_reputation AS e
    ON e.ranking_id = r.ranking_id
),
per_university AS (
  SELECT
    university_id,
    COUNT(*) AS ranking_count,
    SUM(combined_score) AS total_combined_score
  FROM metric_totals
  GROUP BY university_id
)
SELECT
  u.university_name AS university_name,
  pu.ranking_count AS ranking_count,
  ROUND(pu.total_combined_score / pu.ranking_count, 2) AS combined_score_per_ranking
FROM universities AS u
LEFT JOIN per_university AS pu
  ON pu.university_id = u.university_id

gold_sql:
WITH computed_roles AS (
  SELECT
    r.role_id,
    r.role_name,
    r.permissions,
    COUNT(p.permission_id) AS permission_count
  FROM roles AS r
  LEFT JOIN permissions AS p
    ON r.permissions IS NOT NULL
   AND instr(r.permissions, p.permission_name) > 0
  GROUP BY r.role_id, r.role_name, r.permissions
),
qualified_roles AS (
  SELECT
    role_id,
    role_name,
    permissions,
    permission_count
  FROM computed_roles
  WHERE permission_count >= (
    SELECT AVG(permission_count)
    FROM computed_roles
  )
),
ranked_counties AS (
  SELECT
    c.geoid,
    c.county_name,
    c.state,
    c.population,
    c.area,
    qr.role_name,
    qr.permission_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY qr.role_id
      ORDER BY c.population DESC, c.area ASC, c.geoid
    ) AS county_rank
  FROM counties AS c
  CROSS JOIN qualified_roles AS qr
  WHERE c.population IS NOT NULL
    AND c.area IS NOT NULL
    AND (c.population * 1.0 / c.area) >= (
      SELECT AVG(population * 1.0 / area)
      FROM counties
      WHERE population IS NOT NULL
        AND area IS NOT NULL
    )
),
survivors AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ranked_counties
  WHERE county_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  role_name,
  county_name,
  state,
  population,
  area,
  permission_count,
  population * 1.0 / area AS population_density
FROM survivors
WHERE population_density = (
  SELECT MAX(population * 1.0 / area)
  FROM survivors
)
ORDER BY population_density DESC, population DESC, county_name

WITH eligible_areas AS (
  SELECT
    ua.urban_area_id,
    ua.name,
    ua.population AS current_population,
    ua.growth_rate AS current_growth_rate,
    MIN(pd.census_year_id) AS first_census_year_id,
    MAX(pd.census_year_id) AS last_census_year_id,
    COUNT(pd.data_id) AS population_observation_count
  FROM urban_areas AS ua
  JOIN population_data AS pd
    ON pd.urban_area_id = ua.urban_area_id
  JOIN demographic_metrics AS dm
    ON dm.urban_area_id = ua.urban_area_id
   AND dm.year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM demographic_metrics WHERE urban_area_id = ua.urban_area_id)
  WHERE dm.average_income > (
    SELECT AVG(average_income)
    FROM demographic_metrics
    WHERE year = dm.year
  )
  GROUP BY ua.urban_area_id, ua.name, ua.population, ua.growth_rate
),
ranked_areas AS (
  SELECT
    ea.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ea.current_growth_rate DESC, ea.current_population DESC) AS growth_rank
  FROM eligible_areas AS ea
),
survivors AS (
  SELECT
    ra.urban_area_id,
    ra.name,
    ra.current_population,
    ra.current_growth_rate,
    ra.first_census_year_id,
    ra.last_census_year_id,
    ra.population_observation_count
  FROM ranked_areas AS ra
  WHERE ra.growth_rank <= 5
),
final_figures AS (
  SELECT
    s.urban_area_id,
    s.name,
    s.current_population,
    s.current_growth_rate,
    s.population_observation_count,
    cy_first.data_release_date AS first_release_date,
    cy_last.data_release_date AS last_release_date,
    julianday(cy_last.data_release_date) - julianday(cy_first.data_release_date) AS release_span_days
  FROM survivors AS s
  JOIN census_years AS cy_first
    ON cy_first.census_year_id = s.first_census_year_id
  JOIN census_years AS cy_last
    ON cy_last.census_year_id = s.last_census_year_id
)
SELECT
  urban_area_id AS urban_area_id,
  name AS urban_area_name,
  current_population AS current_population,
  current_growth_rate AS current_growth_rate,
  population_observation_count AS population_observation_count,
  first_release_date AS first_release_date,
  last_release_date AS last_release_date,
  release_span_days AS release_span_days
FROM final_figures
ORDER BY release_span_days DESC, current_growth_rate DESC, current_population DESC

WITH eligible_outputs AS (
    SELECT
        d.output_id
    FROM digital_outputs d
    WHERE (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM data_processing_steps s
        WHERE s.output_id = d.output_id
          AND s.is_active = 1
    ) >= 2
    AND (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM data_visualizations v
        WHERE v.output_id = d.output_id
          AND v.is_active = 1
    ) >= 1
),
ranked_outputs AS (
    SELECT
        d.output_id,
        d.output_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.step_id) AS active_step_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT v.vis_id) AS active_vis_count,

            ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.step_id) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT v.vis_id) DESC, d.output_id

    FROM eligible_outputs e
    JOIN digital_outputs d
      ON d.output_id = e.output_id
    LEFT JOIN data_processing_steps s
      ON s.output_id = d.output_id

    LEFT JOIN data_visualizations v
      ON v.output_id = d.output_id
     AND v.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY d.output_id, d.output_name
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS eligible_output_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_ranked_output_count,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS top_ranked_output_percentage
FROM ranked_outputs

WITH reviewer_periods AS (
  SELECT
    r.reviewer_id,
    rv.reviewer_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rev.review_date < '2024-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviews_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rev.review_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviews_2024,

WITH game_counts AS (

),
season_game_totals AS (
  SELECT
    g.season_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.game_id) AS games_in_season
  FROM games g
  GROUP BY g.season_id
),
season_team_stats AS (
  SELECT
    g.season_id,
    gc.team_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.game_id) AS team_games_with_performance,
    SUM(gc.total_points_scored) AS points_scored,
    SUM(gc.total_rebounds) AS rebounds,

season_level AS (
  SELECT
    sts.season_id,
    s.season_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sts.team_id) AS teams_with_performance,

    SUM(sts.points_scored) AS season_points_scored,
    SUM(sts.rebounds) AS season_rebounds,
    SUM(sts.assists) AS season_assists,
    sgt.games_in_season

  JOIN seasons s
    ON s.season_id = sts.season_id
  JOIN season_game_totals sgt
    ON sgt.season_id = sts.season_id
  GROUP BY sts.season_id, s.season_name, sgt.games_in_season
)
SELECT
  season_id,
  season_name,
  teams_with_performance,
  games_in_season,
  total_team_game_rows,
  season_points_scored,
  ROUND(100.0 * total_team_game_rows / (teams_with_performance * games_in_season), 2) AS performance_coverage_pct
FROM season_level

WITH game_level AS (
    SELECT
        g.game_id,
        g.team_id,
        o.opponent_name,
        g.game_date,
        g.score,
        g.outcome,
        g.game_type,
        g.attendance,
        g.tickets_sold,
        g.revenue,
        COUNT(gl.log_id) AS log_count,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN gl.log_date IS NOT NULL AND g.game_date IS NOT NULL
                THEN julianday(gl.log_date) - julianday(g.game_date)
            END
        ) AS avg_log_lag_days
    FROM games AS g
    LEFT JOIN opponents AS o
        ON g.opponent_id = o.opponent_id
    LEFT JOIN game_log AS gl
        ON g.game_id = gl.game_id
    GROUP BY
        g.game_id,
        g.team_id,
        o.opponent_name,
        g.game_date,
        g.score,
        g.outcome,
        g.game_type,
        g.attendance,
        g.tickets_sold,
        g.revenue
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_games,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_games,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_games,
        SUM(CASE WHEN log_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS logged_games,
        AVG(log_count) AS avg_logs_per_game,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN outcome = 'win' THEN log_count
            END
        ) AS avg_logs_per_win_game,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN outcome <> 'win' OR outcome IS NULL THEN log_count
            END
        ) AS avg_logs_per_nonwin_game,
        AVG(avg_log_lag_days) AS avg_log_lag_days
    FROM game_level
)
SELECT
    total_games,
    win_games,
    loss_games,
    logged_games,
    avg_logs_per_game,
    avg_logs_per_win_game,
    avg_logs_per_nonwin_game,
    avg_log_lag_days,
    (avg_logs_per_win_game / NULLIF(avg_logs_per_game, 0)) AS win_log_rate_ratio
FROM summary

WITH eligible_batteries AS (
    SELECT
        b.battery_id,
        b.battery_type_id,
        COUNT(ul.log_id) AS usage_log_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(ul.usage_cycles, 0)) AS total_usage_cycles
    FROM batteries AS b
    JOIN usage_logs AS ul
        ON ul.battery_id = b.battery_id

    HAVING COUNT(ul.log_id) >= 2

ranked_batteries AS (
    SELECT
        eb.battery_id,
        eb.battery_type_id,
        eb.usage_log_count,
        eb.total_usage_cycles,

            PARTITION BY eb.battery_type_id
            ORDER BY eb.total_usage_cycles DESC, eb.battery_id
        ) AS usage_rank
    FROM eligible_batteries AS eb
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        rb.battery_id,
        rb.battery_type_id,
        rb.usage_log_count,
        rb.total_usage_cycles
    FROM ranked_batteries AS rb
    WHERE rb.usage_rank = 1
)

FROM survivors AS s
JOIN battery_types AS bt

LEFT JOIN access_logs AS al

GROUP BY bt.battery_type_id, bt.model

WITH ordered_scores AS (
  SELECT
    gs.gene_id,
    gs.order_num,
    gs.score,
    gs.weight,
    SUM(COALESCE(gs.score, 0)) OVER (
      ORDER BY gs.order_num, gs.gene_id

),
gene_activity AS (
  SELECT
    gs.gene_id,
    gs.order_num,
    gs.score,
    gs.weight,
    COUNT(al.log_id) AS access_log_count,

),
label_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    gl.label_name,
    COUNT(gs.gene_id) AS gene_count,

WITH user_period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    al.user_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.access_date >= '2025-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accesses_recent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.access_date < '2025-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accesses_previous,
    COUNT(DISTINCT al.transaction_id) AS distinct_transactions_accessed,
    AVG(t.latency) AS avg_transaction_latency,
    MAX(t.latency) AS max_transaction_latency,
    MIN(t.latency) AS min_transaction_latency
  FROM access_logs al
  LEFT JOIN transactions t
    ON al.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
  WHERE al.user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY al.user_id
),
ranked_users AS (
  SELECT
    upm.*,
    u.user_name,
    u.role,
    u.department,
    (upm.accesses_recent - upm.accesses_previous) AS access_change,
    ROUND(
      1.0 * upm.accesses_recent / NULLIF(upm.accesses_recent + upm.accesses_previous, 0),
      3
    ) AS recent_access_ratio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY (upm.accesses_recent - upm.accesses_previous) DESC, upm.accesses_recent DESC

  FROM user_period_metrics upm
  LEFT JOIN users u
    ON upm.user_id = u.user_id
)

FROM ranked_users
ORDER BY access_change DESC, accesses_recent DESC, user_id

  ON bs.bioentry_id = cs.bioentry_id

  ON bs.bioentry_id = sc.bioentry_id
WHERE sc.total_shares IS NOT NULL

WITH butterfly_collection_counts AS (

species_collection_stats AS (

    s.species_id,

    s.species,

    ON s.species_id = bcc.species_id
  GROUP BY s.species_id, s.genus, s.species, s.sp_subsp
),
collection_species_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.collection_id,
    c.country,
    c.province,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.butterfly_id) AS butterfly_count,

  FROM collections AS c

    ON c.collection_id = b.collection_id

)
SELECT
  scs.genus AS genus,
  scs.species AS species,
  scs.sp_subsp AS sp_subsp,
  scs.butterfly_count AS butterfly_count,
  ROUND(scs.avg_collection_count, 2) AS avg_collection_count,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * scs.butterfly_count / NULLIF(cst.butterfly_count, 0),

FROM species_collection_stats AS scs

JOIN collection_species_stats AS cst
  ON b.collection_id = cst.collection_id
GROUP BY

WITH interaction_stats AS (

    ON c.customer_id = ci.customer_id

  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    AVG(o.total) AS avg_order_total,
    MAX(o.total) AS max_order_total,
    MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date,

  FROM orders AS o

  COALESCE(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
  ROUND(
    julianday(COALESCE(i.last_interaction_date, c.customer_since)) - julianday(COALESCE(i.first_interaction_date, c.customer_since)),
    2
  ) AS interaction_span_days,
  ROUND(COALESCE(i.avg_days_from_customer_since, 0), 2) AS avg_days_from_customer_since,
  ROUND(COALESCE(o.avg_order_total, 0), 2) AS avg_order_total,
  ROUND(COALESCE(o.max_order_total, 0), 2) AS max_order_total,
  COALESCE(i.distinct_interaction_types, 0) AS distinct_interaction_types,

WITH parameter_scope AS (
  SELECT
    tp.param_id,
    tp.param_name,
    tp.default_value,
    tp.min_value,
    tp.max_value,
    COUNT(pv.value_id) AS value_count,
    AVG(pv.value) AS avg_param_value
  FROM timing_parameters tp
  JOIN parameter_values pv
    ON pv.param_id = tp.param_id
  WHERE tp.default_value IS NOT NULL
    AND tp.min_value IS NOT NULL
    AND tp.max_value IS NOT NULL
    AND pv.value IS NOT NULL
    AND pv.value > tp.default_value
    AND pv.value BETWEEN tp.min_value AND tp.max_value
  GROUP BY tp.param_id, tp.param_name, tp.default_value, tp.min_value, tp.max_value
  HAVING COUNT(pv.value_id) >= 2
),
ranked_scope AS (
  SELECT
    ps.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY ps.avg_param_value DESC, ps.value_count DESC, ps.param_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM parameter_scope ps
),
note_stats AS (
  SELECT
    n.param_id,
    COUNT(*) AS note_count,
    AVG(n.priority) AS avg_note_priority,
    MAX(n.priority) AS max_note_priority
  FROM notes n
  WHERE n.priority IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY n.param_id
)
SELECT
  r.param_id,
  r.param_name,
  r.value_count,
  r.avg_param_value,
  ns.note_count,
  ns.avg_note_priority,
  ns.max_note_priority,
  AVG(r.avg_param_value) OVER () AS overall_avg_param_value
FROM ranked_scope r
LEFT JOIN note_stats ns
  ON ns.param_id = r.param_id
WHERE r.rn <= 10
ORDER BY r.avg_param_value DESC, r.param_id

WITH user_period_counts AS (
    SELECT
        u.user_id,
        u.user_name,
        u.role,
        COUNT(DISTINCT q.query_id) AS queries_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.permission_id) AS permissions_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT q2.query_id) AS queries_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p2.permission_id) AS permissions_2024
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN queries q
        ON u.user_id = q.user_id
       AND q.executed_date >= '2023-01-01'
       AND q.executed_date < '2024-01-01'
    LEFT JOIN permissions p
        ON u.user_id = p.user_id
    LEFT JOIN queries q2
        ON u.user_id = q2.user_id
       AND q2.executed_date >= '2024-01-01'
       AND q2.executed_date < '2025-01-01'
    LEFT JOIN permissions p2
        ON u.user_id = p2.user_id
    GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.role
),
eligible_users AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        user_name,
        role,
        queries_2023,
        permissions_2023,
        queries_2024,
        permissions_2024
    FROM user_period_counts

                user_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM eligible_users
)

    user_id,
    user_name,
    role,
    queries_2023,
    queries_2024,
    permissions_2023,
    permissions_2024,

FROM ranked_users

WITH active_sessions AS (

WITH load_by_data AS (

temp_by_data AS (
  SELECT
    data_id,
    AVG(temperature_lag1) AS avg_temp_lag1,
    AVG(temperature_lag2) AS avg_temp_lag2,
    AVG(temperature_lag3) AS avg_temp_lag3,
    COUNT(*) AS temp_lag_rows
  FROM temperature_lags
  WHERE data_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY data_id
),
data_scope AS (
  SELECT
    ed.data_id,
    ed.site_id,
    ed.month,
    ed.season,
    ed.workdayornot,
    ed.load_actuals_mw,
    lb.avg_load_lag1,
    lb.avg_load_lag2,
    lb.avg_load_lag3,
    lb.load_lag_rows,
    tb.avg_temp_lag1,
    tb.avg_temp_lag2,
    tb.avg_temp_lag3,
    tb.temp_lag_rows
  FROM energy_data AS ed
  LEFT JOIN load_by_data AS lb
    ON lb.data_id = ed.data_id
  LEFT JOIN temp_by_data AS tb
    ON tb.data_id = ed.data_id
)
SELECT
  site_id AS site_id,
  month AS month,
  season AS season,
  COUNT(*) AS energy_rows,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE
      WHEN avg_load_lag1 IS NOT NULL
       AND avg_load_lag2 IS NOT NULL
       AND avg_load_lag3 IS NOT NULL
       AND avg_temp_lag1 IS NOT NULL
       AND avg_temp_lag2 IS NOT NULL
       AND avg_temp_lag3 IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS complete_lag_profile_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(load_actuals_mw), 3) AS avg_load_actuals_mw,
  ROUND(AVG((avg_load_lag1 + avg_load_lag2 + avg_load_lag3) / 3.0), 3) AS avg_load_lag_mean,
  ROUND(AVG((avg_temp_lag1 + avg_temp_lag2 + avg_temp_lag3) / 3.0), 3) AS avg_temp_lag_mean
FROM data_scope
GROUP BY site_id, month, season
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY complete_lag_profile_pct DESC, energy_rows DESC, site_id, month, season

    t.amt

SELECT

  g.gene_name AS gene_name,
  ROUND(COUNT(c.data_id) * 1.0 / 365.0, 4) AS chip_seq_observations_per_day,
  ROUND(COUNT(m.data_id) * 1.0 / 365.0, 4) AS microarray_observations_per_day,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.mark_id) AS distinct_chip_marks,
  ROUND(AVG(c.peak_value), 4) AS avg_peak_value,
  ROUND(AVG(m.expression_value), 4) AS avg_expression_value
FROM genes AS g
JOIN chip_seq_data AS c
  ON g.gene_id = c.gene_id
JOIN microarray_data AS m

GROUP BY g.gene_id, g.gene_name
ORDER BY g.gene_id

WITH all_genes AS (
  SELECT
    g.gene_id,
    g.gene_name
  FROM genes AS g
),
chip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.gene_id,
    COUNT(*) AS chip_seq_observations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.mark_id) AS distinct_chip_marks,
    AVG(c.peak_value) AS avg_peak_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.peak_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonnull_peak_rows
  FROM chip_seq_data AS c
  GROUP BY c.gene_id
),
micro_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.gene_id,
    COUNT(*) AS microarray_observations,
    AVG(m.expression_value) AS avg_expression_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.expression_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonnull_expression_rows
  FROM microarray_data AS m
  GROUP BY m.gene_id
)
SELECT
  ag.gene_id AS gene_id,
  ag.gene_name AS gene_name,
  ROUND(COALESCE(cc.chip_seq_observations, 0) * 1.0 / 365.0, 4) AS chip_seq_observations_per_day,
  ROUND(COALESCE(mc.microarray_observations, 0) * 1.0 / 365.0, 4) AS microarray_observations_per_day,
  COALESCE(cc.distinct_chip_marks, 0) AS distinct_chip_marks,
  ROUND(COALESCE(cc.avg_peak_value, 0), 4) AS avg_peak_value,
  ROUND(COALESCE(mc.avg_expression_value, 0), 4) AS avg_expression_value
FROM all_genes AS ag
LEFT JOIN chip_counts AS cc
  ON ag.gene_id = cc.gene_id
LEFT JOIN micro_counts AS mc
  ON ag.gene_id = mc.gene_id
ORDER BY ag.gene_id
