WITH affected_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.user_name
  FROM users u
  JOIN hyperparameter_history hh
    ON hh.changed_by = u.user_id
  JOIN model_history mh
    ON mh.changed_by = u.user_id
  WHERE hh.previous_value IS NOT NULL
    AND hh.new_value IS NOT NULL
    AND mh.previous_value IS NOT NULL
    AND mh.new_value IS NOT NULL
    AND hh.changed_date IS NOT NULL
    AND mh.changed_date IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday(hh.changed_date) >= julianday('2020-01-01')
    AND julianday(mh.changed_date) >= julianday('2020-01-01')
),
user_change_stats AS (
  SELECT
    au.user_id,
    au.user_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hh.history_id) AS hyperparameter_changes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mh.history_id) AS model_changes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT date(hh.changed_date)) AS hyperparameter_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT date(mh.changed_date)) AS model_days
  FROM affected_users au
  LEFT JOIN hyperparameter_history hh
    ON hh.changed_by = au.user_id
   AND hh.previous_value IS NOT NULL
   AND hh.new_value IS NOT NULL
   AND hh.changed_date IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN model_history mh
    ON mh.changed_by = au.user_id
   AND mh.previous_value IS NOT NULL
   AND mh.new_value IS NOT NULL
   AND mh.changed_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY au.user_id, au.user_name
),
ranked_users AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    user_name,
    hyperparameter_changes,
    model_changes,
    hyperparameter_days,
    model_days,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY (hyperparameter_changes + model_changes) DESC, user_id
    ) AS activity_rank
  FROM user_change_stats
),
final_rates AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    user_name,
    hyperparameter_changes,
    model_changes,
    ROUND(
      CAST(hyperparameter_changes + model_changes AS REAL)
      / NULLIF(hyperparameter_days + model_days, 0),
      3
    ) AS changes_per_day
  FROM ranked_users
  WHERE activity_rank <= 5
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  user_name,
  hyperparameter_changes,
  model_changes,
  changes_per_day
FROM final_rates
ORDER BY changes_per_day DESC, user_id

        (dv.data_value * 100000.0) / NULLIF(dv.population_count, 0) AS per_100k_rate
    FROM data_values AS dv
    JOIN datasets AS d
        ON dv.dataset_id = d.dataset_id
    JOIN measures AS m
        ON dv.measure_id = m.measure_id
    WHERE dv.population_count IS NOT NULL
      AND dv.data_value IS NOT NULL
      AND dv.population_count > 0
      AND m.data_value_unit = '%'
),
qualified_measures AS (
    SELECT
        measure_id,
        measure_name,
        COUNT(*) AS obs_count,
        AVG(per_100k_rate) AS avg_per_100k_rate,
        MAX(per_100k_rate) AS max_per_100k_rate
    FROM measure_rates
    GROUP BY measure_id, measure_name
    HAVING AVG(per_100k_rate) > (
        SELECT AVG(per_100k_rate)
        FROM measure_rates
    )
),
ranked_measures AS (
    SELECT
        qm.measure_id,
        qm.measure_name,
        qm.obs_count,
        qm.avg_per_100k_rate,
        qm.max_per_100k_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY qm.avg_per_100k_rate DESC, qm.obs_count DESC, qm.measure_id
        ) AS rate_rank
    FROM qualified_measures AS qm
)
SELECT
    rm.measure_id AS measure_id,
    rm.measure_name AS measure_name,
    rm.obs_count AS obs_count,
    ROUND(rm.avg_per_100k_rate, 2) AS avg_per_100k_rate,
    ROUND(rm.max_per_100k_rate, 2) AS max_per_100k_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(rm.avg_per_100k_rate) OVER (), 2) AS overall_avg_per_100k_rate
FROM ranked_measures AS rm
WHERE rm.rate_rank <= 5
ORDER BY rm.rate_rank

WITH save_span AS (

    CAST((julianday(MAX(m.last_motion_time)) - julianday(s.created_at)) * 24 * 60 AS REAL),

WITH entry_span AS (
  SELECT
    e.entry_id,
    e.diary_id,
    e.entry_date,
    e.entry_time,
    datetime(e.entry_date || ' ' || e.entry_time) AS entry_ts
  FROM entries e
  WHERE e.entry_date IS NOT NULL
    AND e.entry_time IS NOT NULL
),
access_span AS (
  SELECT
    al.entry_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_accesses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN al.access_type <> 'edit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_edit_accesses,
    MIN(datetime(al.access_date)) AS first_access_ts,
    MAX(datetime(al.access_date)) AS last_access_ts
  FROM access_logs al
  WHERE al.entry_id IS NOT NULL
    AND al.access_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY al.entry_id
)
SELECT
  es.diary_id AS diary_id,
  ROUND(AVG((julianday(aspan.last_access_ts) - julianday(aspan.first_access_ts)) * 24.0), 2) AS avg_access_span_hours,
  ROUND(
    SUM(aspan.non_edit_accesses) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(aspan.total_accesses), 0),
    4
  ) AS non_edit_access_rate
FROM entry_span es
JOIN access_span aspan
  ON aspan.entry_id = es.entry_id
LEFT JOIN annotations a
  ON a.entry_id = es.entry_id
WHERE a.annotation_id IS NULL
   OR a.is_public = 1
GROUP BY es.diary_id
ORDER BY avg_access_span_hours DESC

WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT
    s.user_id,
    COUNT(ke.event_id) AS total_key_events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) AS total_sessions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ke.is_modified = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmodified_key_events
  FROM sessions s
  LEFT JOIN key_events ke
    ON ke.session_id = s.session_id
  INNER JOIN users u
    ON u.user_id = s.user_id
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    total_key_events * 1.0 / NULLIF(unmodified_key_events, 0) AS event_to_unmodified_ratio
  FROM per_user
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN event_to_unmodified_ratio >= 2.0 THEN 'high'
    WHEN event_to_unmodified_ratio >= 1.2 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS ratio_label,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count,
  AVG(event_to_unmodified_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  SUM(total_key_events) AS total_key_events
FROM rates
JOIN per_user USING (user_id)
GROUP BY ratio_label
ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC

WITH entity_instances AS (

    COUNT(DISTINCT ar.request_id) AS archive_request_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ar.request_date IS NOT NULL AND ar.approved_date IS NOT NULL
             THEN julianday(ar.approved_date) - julianday(ar.request_date)
        END) AS avg_archive_request_days,
    MIN(n.created_at) AS first_note_timestamp,
    MAX(n.created_at) AS last_note_timestamp,
    COUNT(DISTINCT n.note_id) AS note_count
  FROM entity_instances ei
  LEFT JOIN archive_requests ar
    ON ar.instance_id = ei.instance_id
  LEFT JOIN notes n
    ON n.instance_id = ei.instance_id
  GROUP BY ei.entity_code
)
SELECT
  e.entity_code,
  e.entity_name,
  COALESCE(s.instance_count, 0) AS instance_count,
  COALESCE(s.archive_request_count, 0) AS archive_request_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s.archive_request_count, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(s.instance_count, 0), 0), 3) AS archive_requests_per_instance,
  ROUND(s.avg_archive_request_days, 2) AS avg_archive_request_days,
  (julianday(s.last_note_timestamp) - julianday(s.first_note_timestamp)) AS note_time_span_days,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s.note_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no_notes'
    WHEN (julianday(s.last_note_timestamp) - julianday(s.first_note_timestamp)) >= 365 THEN 'long_span'
    ELSE 'short_span'
  END AS note_span_label
FROM entities e
LEFT JOIN instance_stats s
  ON s.entity_code = e.entity_code
ORDER BY e.entity_code

  SELECT
    device_id,
    COUNT(*) AS flow_count,
    AVG(CAST(bytes AS REAL)) AS avg_flow_bytes
  FROM flow_records
  WHERE bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY device_id
),
qualified_devices AS (
  SELECT
    nd.device_id,
    nd.device_name,
    nd.device_type,
    COALESCE(ad.alarm_count, 0) AS alarm_count,
    COALESCE(fd.flow_count, 0) AS flow_count
  FROM network_devices nd
  LEFT JOIN alarm_devices ad ON nd.device_id = ad.device_id
  LEFT JOIN flow_devices fd ON nd.device_id = fd.device_id
  WHERE COALESCE(ad.alarm_count, 0) >= 3
    AND COALESCE(fd.flow_count, 0) >= 3
),
device_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    qd.device_id,
    qd.device_name,
    qd.device_type,
    qd.alarm_count,
    qd.flow_count,

    fd.avg_flow_bytes,

WITH rec_track AS (
    SELECT
        r.recommendation_id,
        r.user_id,
        r.track_id,
        t.track_name,
        t.genre,
        t.mood,
        t.popularity AS track_popularity,
        t.duration_ms,
        t.artist_id,
        COUNT(ta.analysis_id) AS analysis_row_count,
        AVG(ta.danceability_avg) AS avg_danceability,
        AVG(ta.energy_avg) AS avg_energy,
        AVG(ta.tempo_avg) AS avg_tempo,
        AVG(ta.popularity_avg) AS avg_analysis_popularity
    FROM recommendations r
    JOIN tracks t
        ON r.track_id = t.track_id
    LEFT JOIN track_analysis ta
        ON t.track_id = ta.track_id
    GROUP BY
        r.recommendation_id,
        r.user_id,
        r.track_id,
        t.track_name,
        t.genre,
        t.mood,
        t.popularity,
        t.duration_ms,
        t.artist_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        recommendation_id,
        user_id,
        track_id,
        track_name,
        genre,
        mood,
        track_popularity,
        analysis_row_count,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(avg_danceability, 0) * 0.35 +
            COALESCE(avg_energy, 0) * 0.35 +
            COALESCE(avg_tempo, 0) * 0.10 +
            COALESCE(avg_analysis_popularity, 0) * 0.20,
            2
        ) AS composite_score,
        CASE
            WHEN (
                COALESCE(avg_danceability, 0) * 0.35 +
                COALESCE(avg_energy, 0) * 0.35 +
                COALESCE(avg_tempo, 0) * 0.10 +
                COALESCE(avg_analysis_popularity, 0) * 0.20
            ) >= 70 THEN 'high'
            WHEN (
                COALESCE(avg_danceability, 0) * 0.35 +
                COALESCE(avg_energy, 0) * 0.35 +
                COALESCE(avg_tempo, 0) * 0.10 +
                COALESCE(avg_analysis_popularity, 0) * 0.20
            ) >= 40 THEN 'medium'
            ELSE 'low'
        END AS score_label
    FROM rec_track
)
SELECT
    score_label,
    COUNT(*) AS recommendation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS distinct_user_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT track_id) AS distinct_track_count,
    AVG(composite_score) AS avg_composite_score,
    MAX(composite_score) AS max_composite_score
FROM scored
GROUP BY score_label
ORDER BY recommendation_count DESC, score_label

WITH qualified_items AS (

    AND oli.lineitem_total IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_date IS NOT NULL
    AND p.created_at IS NOT NULL
    AND (julianday(o.order_date) - julianday(p.created_at)) > 0
    AND (oli.lineitem_total / NULLIF(oli.quantity, 0)) > 0
),

  SELECT
    category,
    line_item_id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,

      PARTITION BY category

top_items AS (

ORDER BY category

WITH experiment_scope AS (
  SELECT
    e.experiment_id,
    e.block_id,
    e.response,
    e.experiment_date,
    COUNT(v.visualization_id) AS visualization_count,
    AVG(s.statistic_value) AS avg_statistic_value
  FROM experiments AS e
  JOIN visualizations AS v
    ON v.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
  LEFT JOIN statistics AS s
    ON s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
   AND s.statistic_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    e.experiment_id,
    e.block_id,
    e.response,
    e.experiment_date
  HAVING
    COUNT(v.visualization_id) >= 2
    AND AVG(s.statistic_value) > e.response
),
ranked_scope AS (
  SELECT
    experiment_id,
    block_id,
    response,
    experiment_date,
    visualization_count,
    avg_statistic_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY block_id
      ORDER BY avg_statistic_value - response DESC, visualization_count DESC, experiment_id

  FROM experiment_scope
),
survivors AS (
  SELECT
    experiment_id,
    block_id,
    response,
    experiment_date,
    visualization_count,
    avg_statistic_value,

)

  MIN(per_row_quantity) AS min_per_row_quantity,
  MAX(per_row_quantity) AS max_per_row_quantity,
  SUM(visualization_count) AS total_visualizations
FROM survivors
GROUP BY block_id
ORDER BY block_id

WITH article_periods AS (
  SELECT
    st.media_id,
    st.theme_id,
    date(st.date) AS trend_date,
    CASE
      WHEN date(st.date) < date('2024-01-01') THEN 'early'
      ELSE 'late'
    END AS period_label
  FROM sentiment_trends AS st
  JOIN media_sources AS ms
    ON ms.media_id = st.media_id
  JOIN themes AS t
    ON t.theme_id = st.theme_id
  WHERE st.media_id IS NOT NULL
    AND st.theme_id IS NOT NULL
    AND st.date IS NOT NULL
),
period_agg AS (
  SELECT
    media_id,
    theme_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trend_count,
    AVG(julianday(trend_date)) AS avg_trend_jd,
    MIN(trend_date) AS first_trend_date,
    MAX(trend_date) AS last_trend_date,
    AVG(CASE WHEN period_label = 'early' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS early_share
  FROM article_periods
  GROUP BY media_id, theme_id
),
period_split AS (
  SELECT
    media_id,
    theme_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN period_label = 'early' THEN julianday(trend_date) END) AS early_avg_jd,
    AVG(CASE WHEN period_label = 'late' THEN julianday(trend_date) END) AS late_avg_jd
  FROM article_periods
  GROUP BY media_id, theme_id
)
SELECT
  ms.media_name AS media_name,
  t.theme_name AS theme_name,
  pa.trend_count AS trend_count,
  ROUND(pa.early_share, 3) AS early_period_ratio,
  ROUND(pa.avg_trend_jd, 3) AS average_trend_julian_day,
  pa.first_trend_date AS first_trend_date,
  pa.last_trend_date AS last_trend_date,
  ROUND(ps.late_avg_jd - ps.early_avg_jd, 3) AS trend_date_change_between_periods
FROM period_agg AS pa
JOIN period_split AS ps
  ON ps.media_id = pa.media_id
 AND ps.theme_id = pa.theme_id
JOIN media_sources AS ms
  ON ms.media_id = pa.media_id
JOIN themes AS t
  ON t.theme_id = pa.theme_id
ORDER BY trend_date_change_between_periods DESC, trend_count DESC

measure: a running or cumulative total over an ordering
gold_sql:
WITH experiment_perf AS (
  SELECT
    e.experiment_id,
    e.experiment_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.access_id) AS access_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.metric_id) AS metric_count,
    AVG(m.average_reaction_time) AS avg_reaction_time,
    MAX(a.access_date) AS latest_access_date,
    SUM(COALESCE(m.accurate_responses, 0)) AS total_accurate_responses,
    SUM(COALESCE(m.total_trials, 0)) AS total_trials
  FROM experiments e
  LEFT JOIN access_logs a
    ON e.experiment_id = a.experiment_id
  LEFT JOIN metrics m
    ON e.experiment_id = m.experiment_id
  GROUP BY e.experiment_id, e.experiment_name
),
ordered_perf AS (
  SELECT
    experiment_id,
    experiment_name,
    access_count,
    metric_count,
    avg_reaction_time,
    latest_access_date,
    total_accurate_responses,
    total_trials,
    CASE
      WHEN total_trials > 0 THEN 1.0 * total_accurate_responses / total_trials
      ELSE NULL
    END AS accuracy_ratio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY COALESCE(latest_access_date, '0000-00-00'), experiment_id
    ) AS access_order,
    SUM(access_count) OVER (
      ORDER BY COALESCE(latest_access_date, '0000-00-00'), experiment_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_access_count
  FROM experiment_perf
)
SELECT
  experiment_id,
  experiment_name,
  access_count,
  metric_count,
  avg_reaction_time,
  latest_access_date,
  accuracy_ratio,
  cumulative_access_count
FROM ordered_perf
ORDER BY access_order

WITH filtered_experiments AS (
    SELECT
        e.experiment_id,
        e.protein_id
    FROM experiments AS e
    JOIN experiment_data AS ed
        ON e.experiment_id = ed.experiment_id

        FROM experiment_data
        WHERE data_quality IS NOT NULL

access_summary AS (
    SELECT
        al.experiment_id,

        ON al.experiment_id = fe.experiment_id

),
ranked_experiments AS (
    SELECT
        experiment_id,
        access_count,
        download_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY (access_count + download_count) DESC, experiment_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM access_summary
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN (access_count + download_count) >= 20 THEN 'high_activity'
        WHEN (access_count + download_count) >= 10 THEN 'medium_activity'
        ELSE 'low_activity'
    END AS activity_label,
    COUNT(*) AS experiment_count
FROM ranked_experiments
WHERE rn <= 10
GROUP BY activity_label
ORDER BY experiment_count DESC, activity_label

  COALESCE(lcc.location_count, 0) AS location_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(oc.ornament_count), 0) AS total_ornament_count,

FROM categories AS c

LEFT JOIN ornament_counts AS oc

LEFT JOIN location_category_counts AS lcc

GROUP BY

  c.category_name,

WITH appraisal_stats AS (

    COUNT(*) AS appraisal_count,

    MAX(CAST(a.appraised_value AS REAL)) AS max_appraised_value,
    MIN(CAST(a.appraised_value AS REAL)) AS min_appraised_value,
    AVG(
      CAST(a.appraised_value AS REAL) - CAST(p.price AS REAL)

  p.property_type AS property_type_label,
  s.appraisal_count,
  s.avg_appraised_value AS headline_avg_appraised_value,

  s.avg_appraisal_minus_list_price AS avg_appraisal_minus_list_price,
  app.appraiser_name AS top_appraiser_name
FROM appraisal_stats s
JOIN properties p
  ON p.property_id = s.property_id

gold_sql:
WITH property_scores AS (
  SELECT
    p.property_id,
    p.agent_id,
    p.location_id,
    p.price,
    p.square_feet,
    p.bedrooms,
    p.bathrooms,
    l.city,
    l.state,
    a.rating,
    (p.price * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.square_feet, 0)) AS price_per_sqft
  FROM properties AS p
  JOIN agents AS a
    ON p.agent_id = a.agent_id
  JOIN locations AS l
    ON p.location_id = l.location_id
  WHERE p.price IS NOT NULL
    AND p.square_feet IS NOT NULL
    AND p.square_feet > 0
    AND a.rating IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_properties AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY price_per_sqft) AS price_quartile
  FROM property_scores
),
survivors AS (
  SELECT
    property_id,
    agent_id,
    location_id,
    city,
    state,
    rating,
    price_per_sqft,
    price_quartile
  FROM ranked_properties
  WHERE price_quartile >= 3
),
agent_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    agent_id,
    city,
    state,
    COUNT(*) AS surviving_properties,
    AVG(price_per_sqft) AS avg_price_per_sqft,
    MIN(price_per_sqft) AS min_price_per_sqft,
    MAX(price_per_sqft) AS max_price_per_sqft,
    AVG(rating) AS avg_agent_rating
  FROM survivors
  GROUP BY agent_id, city, state
)
SELECT
  city AS city_name,
  state AS state_name,
  COUNT(*) AS agent_count,
  SUM(surviving_properties) AS total_surviving_properties,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_price_per_sqft), 2) AS avg_price_per_sqft,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_agent_rating), 2) AS avg_agent_rating,
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(avg_price_per_sqft) >= 500 THEN 'premium'
    WHEN AVG(avg_price_per_sqft) >= 200 THEN 'midrange'
    ELSE 'value'
  END AS price_label
FROM agent_aggregates
GROUP BY city, state
ORDER BY avg_price_per_sqft DESC, city_name, state_name

naive_sql:
SELECT
  m.merchant_name AS merchant_name,
  MIN(l.created_at) AS first_location_created_at,
  MAX(l.updated_at) AS last_location_updated_at,
  ROUND((julianday(MAX(l.updated_at)) - julianday(MIN(l.created_at))), 2) AS location_span_days,
  COUNT(mp.relationship_id) AS participant_count
FROM merchants AS m
JOIN locations AS l
  ON l.merchant_id = m.merchant_id

  ON mp.merchant_id = m.merchant_id

gold_sql:
WITH merchant_location_spans AS (
  SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name,
    MIN(l.created_at) AS first_location_created_at,
    MAX(l.updated_at) AS last_location_updated_at,
    (julianday(MAX(l.updated_at)) - julianday(MIN(l.created_at))) AS location_span_days
  FROM merchants AS m
  LEFT JOIN locations AS l
    ON l.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
  GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name
),
merchant_participant_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    COUNT(mp.relationship_id) AS participant_count
  FROM merchants AS m
  LEFT JOIN merchant_participants AS mp
    ON mp.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
  GROUP BY m.merchant_id
)
SELECT
  mls.merchant_name AS merchant_name,
  mls.first_location_created_at AS first_location_created_at,
  mls.last_location_updated_at AS last_location_updated_at,
  ROUND(mls.location_span_days, 2) AS location_span_days,
  COALESCE(mpc.participant_count, 0) AS participant_count
FROM merchant_location_spans AS mls
LEFT JOIN merchant_participant_counts AS mpc
  ON mpc.merchant_id = mls.merchant_id
ORDER BY mls.location_span_days DESC, mls.merchant_name

gold_sql:
WITH period_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.environment AS environment,
    CASE
      WHEN ts.time_step < 1000 THEN 'early'
      ELSE 'late'
    END AS period,
    AVG(r.reward) AS avg_reward,
    COUNT(r.reward_id) AS reward_count
  FROM agents a
  JOIN time_steps ts
    ON ts.agent_id = a.agent_id
  LEFT JOIN rewards r
    ON r.time_step_id = ts.time_step_id
  WHERE a.environment IS NOT NULL
    AND ts.time_step IS NOT NULL
    AND r.reward_type <> 'negative'
  GROUP BY a.environment, period
),
early_late AS (
  SELECT
    environment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'early' THEN avg_reward END) AS early_avg_reward,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'late' THEN avg_reward END) AS late_avg_reward,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'early' THEN reward_count END) AS early_reward_count,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'late' THEN reward_count END) AS late_reward_count
  FROM period_stats
  GROUP BY environment
)
SELECT
  environment,
  late_avg_reward - early_avg_reward AS avg_reward_change,
  late_reward_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(early_reward_count, 0) AS reward_count_ratio
FROM early_late
WHERE early_avg_reward IS NOT NULL
  AND late_avg_reward IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY avg_reward_change DESC

WITH brand_history_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    bh.brand_id,
    COUNT(*) AS history_event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bh.user_id) AS distinct_historian_count,
    AVG(julianday(bh.action_date) - julianday(b.created_at)) AS avg_days_from_brand_creation,
    MAX(bh.action_date) AS latest_action_date,
    MIN(bh.action_date) AS earliest_action_date,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(
      julianday(MAX(bh.action_date)) - julianday(MIN(bh.action_date)) + 1,
      0
    ) AS history_events_per_day
  FROM brand_history bh
  JOIN brands b
    ON b.brand_id = bh.brand_id
  WHERE bh.action_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bh.brand_id
),
brand_category_stats AS (
  SELECT
    b.brand_id,
    b.brand_name,
    c.category_name,
    b.category_id,
    COALESCE(h.history_event_count, 0) AS history_event_count,
    COALESCE(h.distinct_historian_count, 0) AS distinct_historian_count,
    COALESCE(h.avg_days_from_brand_creation, 0.0) AS avg_days_from_brand_creation,
    COALESCE(h.history_events_per_day, 0.0) AS history_events_per_day,
    h.latest_action_date,
    h.earliest_action_date
  FROM brands b
  LEFT JOIN categories c
    ON c.category_id = b.category_id
  LEFT JOIN brand_history_bounds h
    ON h.brand_id = b.brand_id
)
SELECT
  brand_id,
  brand_name,
  category_name,
  history_event_count,
  distinct_historian_count,
  ROUND(history_events_per_day, 4) AS history_events_per_day,
  ROUND(avg_days_from_brand_creation, 2) AS avg_days_from_brand_creation,
  latest_action_date,
  earliest_action_date,
  CASE
    WHEN history_event_count = 0 THEN 'no_history'
    WHEN history_events_per_day >= 5 THEN 'high_activity'
    WHEN history_events_per_day >= 1 THEN 'moderate_activity'
    ELSE 'low_activity'
  END AS activity_label
FROM brand_category_stats
ORDER BY history_events_per_day DESC, history_event_count DESC, brand_name

measure: a span of time between two timestamps
gold_sql:
WITH reply_activity AS (
    SELECT
        t.tweet_id,
        t.created_at AS tweet_created_at,
        MIN(r.reply_date) AS first_reply_date,
        MAX(r.reply_date) AS last_reply_date,
        COUNT(r.reply_id) AS reply_total
    FROM tweets t
    JOIN replies r
        ON r.tweet_id = t.tweet_id
    WHERE t.created_at IS NOT NULL
      AND r.reply_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.tweet_id, t.created_at
),
eligible_tweets AS (
    SELECT
        tweet_id,
        tweet_created_at,
        first_reply_date,
        last_reply_date,
        reply_total,
        (julianday(last_reply_date) - julianday(tweet_created_at)) AS reply_span_days
    FROM reply_activity
    WHERE reply_total >= 2
      AND reply_span_days IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_tweets AS (
    SELECT
        tweet_id,
        tweet_created_at,
        first_reply_date,
        last_reply_date,
        reply_total,
        reply_span_days,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reply_span_days DESC, reply_total DESC, tweet_id) AS span_rank
    FROM eligible_tweets
)
SELECT
    tweet_id AS tweet_id,
    tweet_created_at AS tweet_created_at,
    first_reply_date AS first_reply_date,
    last_reply_date AS last_reply_date,
    reply_total AS reply_total,
    ROUND(reply_span_days, 3) AS reply_span_days
FROM ranked_tweets
WHERE span_rank <= 5
ORDER BY reply_span_days DESC, reply_total DESC, tweet_id

  COALESCE(s23.sales_qty_2023, 0) - COALESCE(s22.sales_qty_2022, 0) AS sales_qty_change,

WITH active_users AS (
  SELECT u.user_id
  FROM users AS u
  JOIN bugs AS b
    ON b.assignee_id = u.user_id
  JOIN notifications AS n
    ON n.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE u.is_active = 1
    AND b.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')

  GROUP BY u.user_id

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS active_assignee_count,
  COUNT(b.bug_id) AS open_bug_count,
  COUNT(n.notification_id) AS unread_notification_count

WITH user_period_access AS (

    ch.user_id,

),
user_activity AS (

    u.user_id,
    u.user_name,
    COALESCE(upa.accesses_2024, 0) AS accesses_2024,
    COALESCE(upa.accesses_2023, 0) AS accesses_2023,
    COALESCE(cp.comments_2024, 0) AS comments_2024,

WITH simulation_span AS (
    SELECT
        flight_id,
        MIN(time) AS first_sim_time,
        MAX(time) AS last_sim_time,
        COUNT(*) AS simulation_event_count
    FROM flight_simulations
    WHERE time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY flight_id
),
environment_span AS (
    SELECT
        flight_id,
        MIN(time) AS first_condition_time,
        MAX(time) AS last_condition_time,
        COUNT(*) AS condition_event_count
    FROM environmental_conditions
    WHERE time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY flight_id
),
flight_window AS (
    SELECT
        f.flight_id,
        f.mission,
        f.location,
        ss.first_sim_time,
        ss.last_sim_time,
        ss.simulation_event_count,
        es.first_condition_time,
        es.last_condition_time,
        es.condition_event_count,
        (julianday(ss.last_sim_time) - julianday(ss.first_sim_time)) * 24.0 AS simulation_span_hours,
        (julianday(es.last_condition_time) - julianday(es.first_condition_time)) * 24.0 AS condition_span_hours
    FROM flights AS f
    JOIN simulation_span AS ss
        ON f.flight_id = ss.flight_id
    JOIN environment_span AS es
        ON f.flight_id = es.flight_id
)
SELECT
    flight_id,
    mission,
    location,
    simulation_span_hours,
    condition_span_hours,
    simulation_event_count,
    condition_event_count
FROM flight_window
WHERE simulation_span_hours IS NOT NULL
  AND condition_span_hours IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY flight_id

    al.access_id,
    al.user_id,
    al.event_log_id,
    al.access_type,

  JOIN active_users au
    ON al.user_id = au.user_id
  WHERE al.is_active = 1
    AND al.access_date IS NOT NULL
    AND al.event_log_id IS NOT NULL

    lla.*,

  FROM level_linked_access lla

FROM target_set

WITH crop_price_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.crop_id,
    c.crop_name,
    c.crop_type,
    COUNT(mp.price_id) AS total_price_records,
    COUNT(mp.price_id) FILTER (WHERE mp.price_trend = 'increasing') AS increasing_price_records,
    AVG(mp.price) AS avg_market_price,
    COUNT(re.estimation_id) AS total_estimations,
    COUNT(re.estimation_id) FILTER (WHERE re.confidence_level = 'high') AS high_confidence_estimations,
    AVG(re.predicted_revenue) AS avg_predicted_revenue,
    AVG(re.revenue_deficit) AS avg_revenue_deficit
  FROM crops AS c
  LEFT JOIN market_prices AS mp
    ON mp.crop_id = c.crop_id
  LEFT JOIN revenue_estimations AS re
    ON re.crop_id = c.crop_id
  GROUP BY c.crop_id, c.crop_name, c.crop_type
),
ranked_crops AS (
  SELECT
    crop_id,
    crop_name,
    crop_type,
    total_price_records,
    increasing_price_records,
    avg_market_price,
    total_estimations,
    high_confidence_estimations,
    avg_predicted_revenue,
    avg_revenue_deficit,
    ROUND(
      1.0 * increasing_price_records / NULLIF(total_price_records, 0),
      3
    ) AS increasing_price_rate,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY 1.0 * increasing_price_records / NULLIF(total_price_records, 0) DESC,
               avg_predicted_revenue DESC
    ) AS rate_rank
  FROM crop_price_stats
)
SELECT
  crop_name,
  crop_type,
  total_price_records,
  increasing_price_records,
  increasing_price_rate,
  avg_market_price,
  total_estimations,
  high_confidence_estimations,
  avg_predicted_revenue,
  avg_revenue_deficit
FROM ranked_crops
WHERE rate_rank = 1
ORDER BY crop_name

WITH yearly_feature_counts AS (

WITH filtered_requirements AS (
  SELECT r.requirement_id
  FROM requirements AS r
  JOIN requirement_comments AS rc
    ON rc.requirement_id = r.requirement_id
  JOIN requirement_metrics AS rm
    ON rm.requirement_id = r.requirement_id
  WHERE r.priority >= 3
    AND rc.is_resolved = 0
    AND rm.is_key_metric = 1
  GROUP BY r.requirement_id

     AND COUNT(DISTINCT rm.metric_id) >= 1
),
top_requirement AS (

    r.requirement_id,

    ON fr.requirement_id = r.requirement_id
  JOIN requirement_metrics AS rm
    ON rm.requirement_id = r.requirement_id
  GROUP BY r.requirement_id, r.requirement_text
  ORDER BY max_metric_value DESC, r.requirement_id ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  requirement_id AS requirement_id,
  requirement_text AS requirement_text,
  max_metric_value AS max_metric_value
FROM top_requirement

WITH component_connection_counts AS (

WITH metric_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    config_id,
    MIN(timestamp) AS first_metric_timestamp,
    MAX(timestamp) AS last_metric_timestamp,
    COUNT(DISTINCT metric_id) AS distinct_metric_count
  FROM performance_metrics
  WHERE config_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY config_id
),
config_memory AS (
  SELECT
    pm.config_id,
    pm.memory_id,
    COUNT(*) AS metric_rows_for_memory
  FROM performance_metrics AS pm
  WHERE pm.config_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pm.config_id, pm.memory_id
),
top_memory AS (
  SELECT
    config_id,
    memory_id,
    metric_rows_for_memory,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY config_id
      ORDER BY metric_rows_for_memory DESC, memory_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM config_memory
)
SELECT
  hc.config_id AS config_id,
  hc.config_name AS config_name,
  ml.memory_level AS memory_level,
  mb.first_metric_timestamp AS first_metric_timestamp,
  mb.last_metric_timestamp AS last_metric_timestamp,
  ROUND(
    (julianday(mb.last_metric_timestamp) - julianday(mb.first_metric_timestamp)) * 24.0,
    3
  ) AS span_hours,
  mb.distinct_metric_count AS distinct_metric_count,
  tm.metric_rows_for_memory AS dominant_memory_metric_rows
FROM metric_bounds AS mb
JOIN hardware_configurations AS hc
  ON hc.config_id = mb.config_id
LEFT JOIN top_memory AS tm
  ON tm.config_id = mb.config_id
 AND tm.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN memory_levels AS ml
  ON ml.memory_id = tm.memory_id
WHERE mb.first_metric_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND mb.last_metric_timestamp IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY span_hours DESC, hc.config_id

history_scored AS (

WITH selected_cryptos AS (
  SELECT crypto_id, crypto_name
  FROM cryptocurrencies
  WHERE crypto_name IN ('Bitcoin', 'Shiba Inu')
),
price_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ph.crypto_id,
    COUNT(*) AS price_rows,
    SUM(ph.price_usd) AS total_price_usd,
    SUM(ph.volume_usd) AS total_volume_usd
  FROM price_history ph
  JOIN selected_cryptos sc ON sc.crypto_id = ph.crypto_id
  GROUP BY ph.crypto_id
),
analysis_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ma.crypto_id,
    COUNT(*) AS analysis_rows,
    SUM(ma.metric_value) AS total_metric_value
  FROM market_analysis ma
  JOIN selected_cryptos sc ON sc.crypto_id = ma.crypto_id
  WHERE ma.metric_name = 'volatility'
  GROUP BY ma.crypto_id
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    sc.crypto_name,
    COALESCE(pt.price_rows, 0) AS price_rows,
    COALESCE(pt.total_price_usd, 0) AS total_price_usd,
    COALESCE(pt.total_volume_usd, 0) AS total_volume_usd,
    COALESCE(at.analysis_rows, 0) AS analysis_rows,
    COALESCE(at.total_metric_value, 0) AS total_metric_value
  FROM selected_cryptos sc
  LEFT JOIN price_totals pt ON pt.crypto_id = sc.crypto_id
  LEFT JOIN analysis_totals at ON at.crypto_id = sc.crypto_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    crypto_name,
    price_rows,
    total_price_usd,
    total_volume_usd,
    analysis_rows,
    total_metric_value,
    SUM(total_volume_usd) OVER () AS all_selected_volume_usd
  FROM combined
)
SELECT
  'Bitcoin and Shiba Inu' AS crypto_set_name,
  SUM(total_volume_usd) AS set_volume_usd,
  MAX(all_selected_volume_usd) AS total_selected_volume_usd,
  SUM(total_volume_usd) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MAX(all_selected_volume_usd), 0) AS volume_share_of_selected_total,
  SUM(price_rows) AS set_price_rows
FROM ranked

WITH segment_customers AS (
  SELECT
    csm.customer_id
  FROM customer_segment_memberships AS csm
  JOIN customer_segments AS cs
    ON cs.segment_id = csm.segment_id
  JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = csm.customer_id
  WHERE cs.segment_name = 'Segment A'
    AND c.is_active = 1
)
SELECT
  MIN(c.customer_since) AS earliest_customer_since,
  MAX(c.customer_since) AS latest_customer_since,
  (julianday(MAX(c.customer_since)) - julianday(MIN(c.customer_since))) AS customer_since_span_days
FROM customers AS c
WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM segment_customers)

measure: an average or median of a per-row quantity
gold_sql:
WITH filtered_access AS (
    SELECT
        al.access_id,
        al.stat_id,
        al.user_id,
        al.access_date,
        al.access_type,
        al.ip_address,
        al.user_agent
    FROM access_logs AS al
    JOIN crime_reporting AS cr
        ON al.stat_id = cr.crime_id
    JOIN users AS u
        ON al.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE al.access_type = 'download'
      AND u.role = 'analyst'
      AND cr.status = 'open'
      AND al.access_date >= '2023-01-01'
),
ranked_access AS (
    SELECT
        fa.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY fa.user_id
            ORDER BY fa.access_date DESC, fa.access_id DESC
        ) AS access_rank
    FROM filtered_access AS fa
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        ra.user_id,
        ra.stat_id,
        ra.access_id,
        ra.access_date,
        julianday(ra.access_date) - julianday(
            MIN(ra.access_date) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.user_id)
        ) AS days_since_first_access
    FROM ranked_access AS ra
    WHERE ra.access_rank <= 3
)
SELECT
    user_id AS user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS survivor_access_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT stat_id) AS distinct_stat_count,
    AVG(days_since_first_access) AS average_days_since_first_access,
    MIN(access_date) AS first_survivor_access_date,
    MAX(access_date) AS last_survivor_access_date
FROM survivors
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY average_days_since_first_access DESC, survivor_access_count DESC

WITH customer_order_stats AS (

gold_sql:
WITH feedback_totals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(rating) AS total_rating,
        COUNT(*) AS feedback_count
    FROM customer_feedback
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
preference_totals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS preference_count
    FROM customer_preferences
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_scores AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.first_name,
        c.last_name,
        COALESCE(f.total_rating, 0) AS total_rating,
        COALESCE(f.feedback_count, 0) AS feedback_count,
        COALESCE(p.preference_count, 0) AS preference_count,
        COALESCE(f.total_rating, 0) + COALESCE(p.preference_count, 0) AS score
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN feedback_totals f
        ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN preference_totals p
        ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
),
ordered_scores AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        score,
        SUM(score) OVER (
            ORDER BY score DESC, customer_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_score
    FROM customer_scores
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    score AS customer_score,
    running_score AS cumulative_score
FROM ordered_scores
ORDER BY score DESC, customer_id

WITH type_stats AS (
  SELECT
    e.type_id,
    et.type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN e.severity = 'high' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS high_severity_ratio,
    AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(e.comment, ''))) AS avg_comment_length,
    MAX(e.date) AS latest_event_date
  FROM events e
  JOIN event_types et ON et.type_id = e.type_id
  GROUP BY e.type_id, et.type_name
),
type_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(event_count) AS total_event_count
  FROM type_stats
)
SELECT
  ts.type_id,
  ts.type_name,
  ts.event_count,
  ROUND(ts.event_count * 1.0 / tt.total_event_count, 4) AS event_share_of_total,
  ROUND(ts.high_severity_ratio, 4) AS high_severity_ratio,
  ROUND(ts.avg_comment_length, 2) AS avg_comment_length,
  ts.latest_event_date,
  COALESCE(ti.description, 'unknown') AS to_id_label
FROM type_stats ts
CROSS JOIN type_total tt
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    e.type_id,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tid.description) AS description
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN to_ids tid ON tid.to_id = e.to_id
  GROUP BY e.type_id
) ti ON ti.type_id = ts.type_id
ORDER BY event_share_of_total DESC, ts.type_name

WITH case_activity AS (
  SELECT
    cc.case_id,
    cc.region_id,
    MIN(COALESCE(dr.death_date, rr.recovery_date)) AS first_event_date,
    MAX(COALESCE(dr.death_date, rr.recovery_date)) AS last_event_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dr.death_id) AS death_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rr.recovery_id) AS recovery_count,
    AVG(dr.age) AS avg_death_age,
    MAX(dr.age) AS max_death_age,
    MIN(rr.recovery_date) AS earliest_recovery_date,
    MAX(rr.recovery_date) AS latest_recovery_date
  FROM covid_cases AS cc
  LEFT JOIN death_records AS dr
    ON dr.case_id = cc.case_id
  LEFT JOIN recovery_records AS rr
    ON rr.case_id = cc.case_id
  GROUP BY cc.case_id, cc.region_id
)
SELECT
  region_id,
  case_id,
  (julianday(last_event_date) - julianday(first_event_date)) AS event_span_days,
  death_count,
  recovery_count,
  CASE
    WHEN recovery_count = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(CAST(death_count AS REAL) / recovery_count, 3)
  END AS death_to_recovery_ratio,
  ROUND(avg_death_age, 1) AS avg_death_age,
  max_death_age,
  earliest_recovery_date,
  latest_recovery_date
FROM case_activity
ORDER BY event_span_days DESC, death_count DESC

WITH relevant_failures AS (
  SELECT
    pf.failure_id,
    pf.process_id,
    pf.failure_time,
    pf.failure_reason,
    COUNT(ar.rule_id) AS matching_rules
  FROM process_failures AS pf
  JOIN processes AS p
    ON p.process_id = pf.process_id
  JOIN alert_rules AS ar
    ON ar.process_id = p.process_id
  WHERE p.process_status = 'running'
    AND pf.failure_time IS NOT NULL
    AND ar.rule_condition IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (ar.rule_condition LIKE '%CPU%' AND pf.failure_reason LIKE '%System%')
      OR (ar.rule_condition LIKE '%network%' AND pf.failure_reason LIKE '%Network%')
      OR (ar.rule_condition NOT LIKE '%CPU%' AND ar.rule_condition NOT LIKE '%network%')
    )
  GROUP BY pf.failure_id, pf.process_id, pf.failure_time, pf.failure_reason
),
ranked_failures AS (
  SELECT
    failure_id,
    process_id,
    failure_time,
    failure_reason,
    matching_rules,

  FROM relevant_failures
)
SELECT

  AVG(julianday('now') - julianday(failure_time)) AS avg_days_since_failure,

FROM ranked_failures

GROUP BY process_id

)

WITH reviewed_employees AS (
    SELECT
        pr.employee_id,
        AVG(pr.rating) AS avg_rating,
        COUNT(*) AS review_count
    FROM performance_reviews pr
    WHERE pr.rating IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pr.employee_id
    HAVING AVG(pr.rating) > (
        SELECT AVG(rating)
        FROM performance_reviews
        WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
    )
),
qualified_tax_base AS (
    SELECT
        e.employee_id,
        e.name,
        e.hire_date,
        e.termination_date,
        re.avg_rating,
        re.review_count,
        SUM(tr.tax_amount) AS total_tax_amount,
        julianday(COALESCE(e.termination_date, '2026-11-01')) - julianday(e.hire_date) AS active_days
    FROM employees e
    JOIN reviewed_employees re
        ON re.employee_id = e.employee_id
    LEFT JOIN tax_records tr
        ON tr.employee_id = e.employee_id
    WHERE e.hire_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.name, e.hire_date, e.termination_date, re.avg_rating, re.review_count
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        *,

FROM survivors
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY tax_per_day DESC

WITH filtered_data AS (
    SELECT
        pd.data_id,
        pd.prevalence_percent,
        pd.year_id,
        pd.sex_id
    FROM prevalence_data AS pd
    JOIN sex AS s
        ON pd.sex_id = s.sex_id
    WHERE pd.sex_id IN (
        SELECT sex_id
        FROM prevalence_data
        GROUP BY sex_id
        HAVING AVG(prevalence_percent) > (
            SELECT AVG(prevalence_percent) FROM prevalence_data
        )
    )
),
ranked_years AS (
    SELECT
        fd.data_id,
        fd.prevalence_percent,
        y.year_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY fd.sex_id
            ORDER BY y.year_name
        ) AS year_rank
    FROM filtered_data AS fd
    JOIN years AS y
        ON fd.year_id = y.year_id
),
paired_periods AS (
    SELECT
        sex_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year_rank = 1 THEN prevalence_percent END) AS first_period_prevalence,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year_rank = 2 THEN prevalence_percent END) AS second_period_prevalence,
        COUNT(*) AS periods_found
    FROM (
        SELECT
            fd.sex_id,
            fd.prevalence_percent,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY fd.sex_id
                ORDER BY y.year_name
            ) AS year_rank
        FROM filtered_data AS fd
        JOIN years AS y
            ON fd.year_id = y.year_id
    ) AS ordered_periods
    GROUP BY sex_id
)
SELECT
    s.sex_name AS sex_name,
    pp.first_period_prevalence AS first_period_prevalence,
    pp.second_period_prevalence AS second_period_prevalence,
    (pp.second_period_prevalence - pp.first_period_prevalence) AS prevalence_change,
    pp.periods_found AS periods_found
FROM paired_periods AS pp
JOIN sex AS s
    ON pp.sex_id = s.sex_id
WHERE pp.periods_found >= 2
ORDER BY prevalence_change DESC

gold_sql:
WITH event_totals AS (
  SELECT
    e.data_id AS event_id,
    e.event_date,
    e.source,
    COUNT(f.fatality_id) AS fatality_records,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.fatality_count), 0) AS total_fatalities,
    AVG(f.fatality_count) AS avg_fatalities_per_record,
    MAX(f.fatality_count) AS max_fatalities_in_record
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN fatalities f
    ON f.event_id = e.data_id
  GROUP BY e.data_id, e.event_date, e.source
),
running AS (
  SELECT
    et.*,
    SUM(et.total_fatalities) OVER (ORDER BY et.event_date, et.event_id) AS cumulative_fatalities
  FROM event_totals et
)
SELECT
  r.event_id,
  r.event_date,
  s.source_name AS source_name,
  r.fatality_records AS fatality_record_count,
  r.total_fatalities AS total_fatalities,
  ROUND(1.0 * r.total_fatalities / NULLIF(r.fatality_records, 0), 2) AS fatalities_per_record_ratio,
  ROUND(r.avg_fatalities_per_record, 2) AS avg_fatalities_per_record,
  r.max_fatalities_in_record AS max_fatalities_in_record,
  r.cumulative_fatalities AS cumulative_fatalities
FROM running r
LEFT JOIN sources s
  ON s.source_name = r.source
ORDER BY r.event_date, r.event_id

WITH dataset_periods AS (
  SELECT
    d.dataset_id,
    d.date,
    CASE
      WHEN d.date < '2024-01-01' THEN 'period_1'
      ELSE 'period_2'
    END AS period_label
  FROM datasets d
),
period_values AS (
  SELECT
    dp.period_label,
    dv.dataset_id,
    dv.value
  FROM data_values dv
  JOIN dataset_periods dp
    ON dp.dataset_id = dv.dataset_id
  WHERE dv.value IS NOT NULL
),
period_stats AS (
  SELECT
    pv.period_label,
    COUNT(*) AS value_count,
    AVG(pv.value) AS avg_value,
    SUM(pv.value) AS total_value
  FROM period_values pv
  GROUP BY pv.period_label
),
access_counts AS (
  SELECT
    dp.period_label,
    COUNT(*) AS access_count
  FROM access_logs al
  JOIN dataset_periods dp
    ON dp.dataset_id = al.dataset_id
  GROUP BY dp.period_label
),
period_summary AS (
  SELECT
    ps.period_label,
    ps.value_count,
    ps.avg_value,
    ps.total_value,
    ac.access_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.period_label) AS period_rank
  FROM period_stats ps
  JOIN access_counts ac
    ON ac.period_label = ps.period_label
)
SELECT
  p1.period_label AS period_1,
  p2.period_label AS period_2,
  p1.avg_value AS avg_value_period_1,
  p2.avg_value AS avg_value_period_2,
  (p2.avg_value - p1.avg_value) AS avg_value_change,
  (p2.total_value - p1.total_value) AS total_value_change,
  (p2.access_count - p1.access_count) AS access_count_change
FROM period_summary p1
JOIN period_summary p2
  ON p1.period_rank = 1
 AND p2.period_rank = 2

WITH nomination_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    p.production_id,
    p.title,
    p.production_company_id,
    MIN(n.year) AS first_nomination_year,
    MAX(n.year) AS last_nomination_year,
    COUNT(*) AS nomination_count
  FROM productions AS p
  JOIN nominations AS n
    ON n.production_id = p.production_id
  GROUP BY
    p.production_id,
    p.title,
    p.production_company_id
),
company_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    company_id,
    company_name,
    address
  FROM production_companies
)
SELECT
  c.company_name AS company_name,
  nr.title AS production_title,
  nr.nomination_count AS nomination_count,
  nr.first_nomination_year AS first_nomination_year,
  nr.last_nomination_year AS last_nomination_year,
  (date(nr.last_nomination_year || '-01-01') - date(nr.first_nomination_year || '-01-01')) AS nomination_span_days
FROM nomination_rollup AS nr
JOIN company_rollup AS c
  ON c.company_id = nr.production_company_id
ORDER BY
  nomination_span_days DESC,
  nr.nomination_count DESC,
  c.company_name ASC,

WITH player_team_totals AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name AS player_name,
    p.player_team AS player_team,
    SUM(per.points) AS total_points
  FROM performances AS per
  JOIN players AS p
    ON per.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.player_team IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, p.player_team
),
qualified_players AS (
  SELECT
    pt.player_id,
    pt.player_name,
    pt.player_team,
    pt.total_points,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pt.player_team
      ORDER BY pt.total_points DESC, pt.player_name
    ) AS team_rank
  FROM player_team_totals AS pt
  WHERE pt.total_points > (
    SELECT AVG(total_points)
    FROM player_team_totals
    WHERE player_team = pt.player_team
  )
)
SELECT

  ROUND(qp.total_points * 1.0 / SUM(qp.total_points) OVER (), 4) AS points_share_of_qualified_total
FROM qualified_players AS qp
WHERE qp.team_rank <= 2
ORDER BY points_share_of_qualified_total DESC, qp.total_points DESC

WITH period_stats AS (
  SELECT
    mh.model_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mh.changed_date < '2024-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS changes_before_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mh.changed_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS changes_from_2024,
    COUNT(*) AS total_changes
  FROM model_history AS mh
  GROUP BY mh.model_id
),
model_periods AS (
  SELECT
    ps.model_id,
    m.model_name,
    ps.changes_before_2024,
    ps.changes_from_2024,
    ps.total_changes,
    ps.changes_from_2024 * 1.0 / NULLIF(ps.total_changes - ps.changes_before_2024, 0) AS post_2024_rate

    ON m.model_id = ps.model_id
)
SELECT
  mp.model_name,
  mp.changes_before_2024,
  mp.changes_from_2024,
  mp.post_2024_rate
FROM model_periods AS mp
ORDER BY (mp.changes_from_2024 - mp.changes_before_2024) DESC, mp.model_name

gold_sql:
WITH restaurant_base AS (
  SELECT
    r.restaurant_id,
    r.restaurant_name,
    r.city,
    r.state
  FROM restaurants r
),
program_sales AS (
  SELECT
    lp.restaurant_id,
    lp.program_id,
    COUNT(sr.sale_id) AS sale_count,
    COUNT(*) AS program_count
  FROM loyalty_programs lp
  LEFT JOIN sales_records sr
    ON sr.restaurant_id = lp.restaurant_id
  GROUP BY lp.restaurant_id, lp.program_id
),
restaurant_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    rb.restaurant_id,
    rb.restaurant_name,
    rb.city,
    rb.state,
    COUNT(ps.program_id) AS loyalty_program_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(ps.sale_count), 0) AS total_sales_record_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(ps.program_count), 0) AS total_program_rows,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(ps.program_id) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(SUM(ps.sale_count), 0) / COUNT(ps.program_id)
    END AS avg_sales_records_per_program
  FROM restaurant_base rb
  LEFT JOIN program_sales ps
    ON ps.restaurant_id = rb.restaurant_id
  GROUP BY rb.restaurant_id, rb.restaurant_name, rb.city, rb.state
)
SELECT
  restaurant_id,
  restaurant_name,
  city,
  state,
  loyalty_program_count,
  total_sales_record_count,
  total_program_rows,
  avg_sales_records_per_program
FROM restaurant_metrics
ORDER BY avg_sales_records_per_program DESC, restaurant_name

WITH product_spans AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.category_id,
    p.supplier_id,
    MIN(p.created_at) AS product_created_at,
    MAX(p.updated_at) AS product_updated_at,
    julianday(MAX(p.updated_at)) - julianday(MIN(p.created_at)) AS product_lifecycle_days
  FROM products p
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category_id, p.supplier_id
),
category_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.product_id) AS product_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.supplier_id) AS supplier_count,
    AVG(ps.product_lifecycle_days) AS avg_product_lifecycle_days,
    MIN(ps.product_created_at) AS first_product_created_at,
    MAX(ps.product_updated_at) AS last_product_updated_at,
    julianday(MAX(ps.product_updated_at)) - julianday(MIN(ps.product_created_at)) AS category_time_span_days
  FROM categories c
  LEFT JOIN product_spans ps
    ON ps.category_id = c.category_id
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
),
supplier_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    s.supplier_id,
    s.supplier_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.product_id) AS products_supplied,
    AVG(ps.product_lifecycle_days) AS avg_product_lifecycle_days,
    MIN(ps.product_created_at) AS first_product_created_at,
    MAX(ps.product_updated_at) AS last_product_updated_at,
    julianday(MAX(ps.product_updated_at)) - julianday(MIN(ps.product_created_at)) AS supplier_time_span_days
  FROM suppliers s
  LEFT JOIN product_spans ps
    ON ps.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
  GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name
)
SELECT
  cr.category_id,
  cr.category_name,
  cr.product_count,
  cr.supplier_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(cr.avg_product_lifecycle_days, 0), 2) AS avg_product_lifecycle_days,
  ROUND(COALESCE(cr.category_time_span_days, 0), 2) AS category_time_span_days,
  CASE
    WHEN cr.product_count >= 5 THEN 'high_product_volume'
    WHEN cr.product_count >= 1 THEN 'low_product_volume'
    ELSE 'no_products'
  END AS volume_label,
  sr.supplier_name AS top_supplier_name,
  ROUND(COALESCE(sr.supplier_time_span_days, 0), 2) AS top_supplier_time_span_days
FROM category_rollup cr
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    supplier_id,
    supplier_name,
    supplier_time_span_days,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY products_supplied DESC, supplier_time_span_days DESC, supplier_name) AS rn
  FROM supplier_rollup
) sr
  ON sr.rn = 1
ORDER BY cr.category_id

WITH eligible_access AS (

    al.user_id,

    al.access_type,

      PARTITION BY ea.transaction_id
      ORDER BY ea.access_count_in_pair DESC, ea.access_date ASC, ea.user_id ASC

  FROM eligible_access AS ea
),
survivors AS (
  SELECT
    ra.transaction_id,

gold_sql:
WITH soil AS (
  SELECT
    stand_id,
    COUNT(*) AS soil_record_count,
    AVG(mass) AS avg_soil_mass,
    MAX(mass) AS max_soil_mass,
    MIN(mass) AS min_soil_mass,
    SUM(mass) AS total_soil_mass
  FROM carbon_mass_soil_pool
  WHERE stand_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stand_id
),
veg AS (
  SELECT
    stand_id,
    COUNT(*) AS veg_record_count,
    AVG(mass) AS avg_veg_mass,
    MAX(mass) AS max_veg_mass,
    MIN(mass) AS min_veg_mass,
    SUM(mass) AS total_veg_mass
  FROM carbon_mass_vegetation
  WHERE stand_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stand_id
)
SELECT
  fs.stand_id AS stand_id,
  fs.stand_name AS stand_name,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_soil_mass, 0.0) / NULLIF(fs.area, 0), 3) AS soil_mass_per_area,
  ROUND(COALESCE(v.total_veg_mass, 0.0) / NULLIF(fs.area, 0), 3) AS vegetation_mass_per_area,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_soil_mass, 0.0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(v.total_veg_mass, 0.0), 0), 3) AS soil_to_vegetation_mass_ratio,
  ROUND((COALESCE(s.total_soil_mass, 0.0) + COALESCE(v.total_veg_mass, 0.0)) / NULLIF(fs.area, 0), 3) AS total_carbon_mass_per_area,
  COALESCE(s.soil_record_count, 0) AS soil_record_count,
  COALESCE(v.veg_record_count, 0) AS vegetation_record_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s.avg_soil_mass, 0.0), 3) AS avg_soil_mass,
  ROUND(COALESCE(v.avg_veg_mass, 0.0), 3) AS avg_vegetation_mass,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s.total_soil_mass, 0.0) >= COALESCE(v.total_veg_mass, 0.0) THEN 'soil_dominant'
    ELSE 'vegetation_dominant'
  END AS dominant_carbon_pool
FROM forest_stands AS fs
LEFT JOIN soil AS s
  ON fs.stand_id = s.stand_id
LEFT JOIN veg AS v

WITH project_feedback AS (
  SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.project_name,
    p.status,
    COUNT(f.feedback_id) AS feedback_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_feedback_count

    ON p.project_id = f.project_id
  GROUP BY
    p.project_id,
    p.project_name,
    p.status
),
project_finance AS (
  SELECT
    p.project_id,
    COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(ft.amount) AS total_transaction_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'investment' THEN ft.amount ELSE 0 END) AS investment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type <> 'expense' OR ft.transaction_type IS NULL THEN ft.amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_expense_amount
  FROM projects AS p
  LEFT JOIN financial_transactions AS ft
    ON p.project_id = ft.project_id
  GROUP BY
    p.project_id
)
SELECT
  pf.project_id AS project_id,
  pf.project_name AS project_name,
  pf.status AS project_status,
  pf.feedback_count AS feedback_count,
  pf.positive_feedback_count AS positive_feedback_count,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * pf.positive_feedback_count / NULLIF(pf.feedback_count, 0),
    3
  ) AS positive_feedback_rate,
  pfin.transaction_count AS transaction_count,
  ROUND(pfin.total_transaction_amount, 2) AS total_transaction_amount,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * pfin.investment_amount / NULLIF(pfin.non_expense_amount, 0),
    3
  ) AS investment_to_non_expense_ratio,
  CASE
    WHEN 1.0 * pf.positive_feedback_count / NULLIF(pf.feedback_count, 0) >= 0.75
      AND 1.0 * pfin.investment_amount / NULLIF(pfin.non_expense_amount, 0) >= 0.50
      THEN 'high'
    WHEN 1.0 * pf.positive_feedback_count / NULLIF(pf.feedback_count, 0) >= 0.50
      THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS performance_label
FROM project_feedback AS pf
JOIN project_finance AS pfin
  ON pf.project_id = pfin.project_id
ORDER BY
  performance_label DESC,
  positive_feedback_rate DESC,
  investment_to_non_expense_ratio DESC,
  pf.project_id

gold_sql:
WITH indicator_stats AS (
    SELECT
        dv.indicator_id,
        dv.country_id,
        COUNT(*) AS value_count,
        AVG(dv.value) AS avg_value
    FROM data_values AS dv
    WHERE dv.value IS NOT NULL
      AND dv.country_id IS NOT NULL
      AND dv.indicator_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY dv.indicator_id, dv.country_id
),
eligible_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        indicator_id,
        country_id,
        value_count,
        avg_value,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY indicator_id ORDER BY value_count DESC, avg_value DESC) AS country_rank
    FROM indicator_stats
),
top_countries AS (
    SELECT
        ep.indicator_id,
        ep.country_id,
        ep.value_count,
        ep.avg_value
    FROM eligible_pairs AS ep
    WHERE ep.country_rank = 1
),
indicator_totals AS (
    SELECT
        dv.indicator_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_value_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT dv.country_id) AS country_coverage
    FROM data_values AS dv
    WHERE dv.value IS NOT NULL
      AND dv.country_id IS NOT NULL
      AND dv.indicator_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY dv.indicator_id
),
final_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        i.indicator_name,
        c.country_name,
        tc.value_count AS top_country_value_count,
        it.total_value_count,
        it.country_coverage,
        ROUND(100.0 * tc.value_count / NULLIF(it.total_value_count, 0), 2) AS top_country_value_share_pct
    FROM top_countries AS tc
    JOIN indicator_totals AS it
      ON it.indicator_id = tc.indicator_id
    JOIN indicators AS i
      ON i.indicator_id = tc.indicator_id
    JOIN countries AS c
      ON c.country_id = tc.country_id
)
SELECT
    indicator_name,
    country_name,
    top_country_value_count,
    total_value_count,
    country_coverage,
    top_country_value_share_pct
FROM final_metrics
ORDER BY top_country_value_share_pct DESC, top_country_value_count DESC, indicator_name, country_name

WITH horse_event_stats AS (
  SELECT
    h.horse_id,
    h.horse_name,
    COUNT(rr.result_id) AS total_results,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rr.finishing_position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rr.finishing_position IS NOT NULL AND rr.finishing_position <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top3_finishes
  FROM horses h
  JOIN racing_results rr
    ON rr.horse_id = h.horse_id
  JOIN racing_events re
    ON re.event_id = rr.event_id
  WHERE re.date IS NOT NULL
    AND rr.finishing_position IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY h.horse_id, h.horse_name
),
labeled_rates AS (
  SELECT
    horse_name,
    1.0 * wins / NULLIF(total_results, 0) AS win_rate,
    1.0 * top3_finishes / NULLIF(total_results - wins, 0) AS top3_rate_excluding_wins,
    CASE
      WHEN 1.0 * wins / NULLIF(total_results, 0) >= 0.30 THEN 'elite'
      WHEN 1.0 * wins / NULLIF(total_results, 0) >= 0.15 THEN 'strong'
      WHEN 1.0 * wins / NULLIF(total_results, 0) >= 0.05 THEN 'competitive'
      ELSE 'developing'
    END AS performance_label
  FROM horse_event_stats
)
SELECT
  horse_name,
  performance_label,
  win_rate,
  top3_rate_excluding_wins
FROM labeled_rates

WITH reading_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.sensor_id,
        s.equipment_id,
        s.sensor_name,
        t.threshold_id,
        t.alert_level AS threshold_alert_level,
        AVG(r.reading_value) AS avg_reading_value
    FROM sensors AS s
    JOIN readings AS r
        ON r.sensor_id = s.sensor_id
    JOIN thresholds AS t
        ON t.sensor_id = s.sensor_id
    WHERE r.reading_value IS NOT NULL
      AND t.min_value IS NOT NULL
      AND t.max_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        s.sensor_id,
        s.equipment_id,
        s.sensor_name,
        t.threshold_id,
        t.alert_level
),
classified_sensors AS (
    SELECT
        sensor_id,
        equipment_id,
        sensor_name,
        threshold_id,
        threshold_alert_level,
        avg_reading_value,
        CASE
            WHEN avg_reading_value < (SELECT min_value FROM thresholds WHERE threshold_id = reading_stats.threshold_id) THEN 'below_threshold'
            WHEN avg_reading_value > (SELECT max_value FROM thresholds WHERE threshold_id = reading_stats.threshold_id) THEN 'above_threshold'
            ELSE 'within_threshold'
        END AS computed_band
    FROM reading_stats
),
ranked_sensors AS (
    SELECT
        sensor_id,
        equipment_id,
        sensor_name,
        threshold_id,
        threshold_alert_level,
        avg_reading_value,
        computed_band,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY threshold_alert_level
            ORDER BY avg_reading_value DESC, sensor_id
        ) AS band_rank
    FROM classified_sensors
    WHERE computed_band = 'above_threshold'
),
final_summary AS (
    SELECT
        threshold_alert_level,
        COUNT(*) AS sensor_count,
        AVG(avg_reading_value) AS avg_excess_reading,
        MIN(avg_reading_value) AS min_excess_reading,
        MAX(avg_reading_value) AS max_excess_reading
    FROM ranked_sensors
    WHERE band_rank <= 3
    GROUP BY threshold_alert_level
)
SELECT
    threshold_alert_level AS alert_level_label,
    sensor_count AS top_sensor_count,
    avg_excess_reading AS mean_reading_value,
    min_excess_reading AS lowest_reading_value,
    max_excess_reading AS highest_reading_value
FROM final_summary
ORDER BY mean_reading_value DESC

WITH indicator_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    ei.country_id,
    ei.indicator_type_id,
    ei.methodology_id,
    ei.start_date,
    ei.indicator_value,
    SUM(ei.indicator_value) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ei.country_id, ei.indicator_type_id
      ORDER BY ei.start_date, ei.indicator_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_indicator_value
  FROM economic_indicators AS ei
  JOIN indicator_types AS it
    ON ei.indicator_type_id = it.indicator_type_id
  LEFT JOIN methodologies AS m
    ON ei.methodology_id = m.methodology_id
),
methodology_ratio AS (
  SELECT
    country_id,
    indicator_type_id,
    MAX(cumulative_indicator_value) AS final_cumulative_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN methodology_id IS NOT NULL THEN indicator_value END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(*) AS methodology_coverage_rate
  FROM indicator_rollup
  GROUP BY country_id, indicator_type_id
)
SELECT
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  it.indicator_type_name AS indicator_type_name,
  mr.final_cumulative_value AS cumulative_indicator_value,
  mr.methodology_coverage_rate AS methodology_coverage_rate
FROM methodology_ratio AS mr
JOIN countries AS c

WITH filtered_products AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        p.category_id,
        p.supplier_id,
        p.stock_quantity
    FROM products p
    WHERE p.stock_quantity > (
        SELECT AVG(stock_quantity)
        FROM products
        WHERE stock_quantity IS NOT NULL
    )
),
category_supplier_activity AS (
    SELECT
        c.category_id,
        c.category_name,
        s.supplier_id,
        s.supplier_name,
        COUNT(fp.product_id) AS product_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.category_id
            ORDER BY COUNT(fp.product_id) DESC, s.supplier_name
        ) AS supplier_rank
    FROM filtered_products fp
    JOIN categories c
        ON fp.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN suppliers s
        ON fp.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        category_id,
        category_name,
        supplier_id,
        supplier_name,
        product_count
    FROM category_supplier_activity
    WHERE supplier_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    category_name AS category_name,
    supplier_name AS top_supplier_name,
    MIN(p.created_at) AS first_timestamp,
    MAX(p.created_at) AS last_timestamp,
    (julianday(MAX(p.created_at)) - julianday(MIN(p.created_at))) AS time_span_days
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.category_name,
        s.supplier_name,
        i.date_added AS created_at
    FROM survivors s
    JOIN products p
        ON p.category_id = s.category_id
       AND p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
    JOIN inventory i
        ON i.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE i.date_added IS NOT NULL
) p
GROUP BY category_name, top_supplier_name
ORDER BY time_span_days DESC, category_name

WITH session_app_feedback AS (
    SELECT
        s.application_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) AS session_count,
        SUM(s.session_duration) AS total_session_duration,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.feedback_id) AS feedback_count,
        AVG(f.feedback_rating) AS avg_feedback_rating
    FROM sessions AS s
    LEFT JOIN user_feedback AS f
        ON s.application_id = f.application_id
    GROUP BY s.application_id
),
app_summary AS (
    SELECT
        a.application_id,
        a.application_name,
        COALESCE(saf.session_count, 0) AS session_count,
        COALESCE(saf.total_session_duration, 0) AS total_session_duration,
        COALESCE(saf.feedback_count, 0) AS feedback_count,
        COALESCE(saf.avg_feedback_rating, 0) AS avg_feedback_rating,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(saf.feedback_count, 0) >= 100 AND COALESCE(saf.total_session_duration, 0) >= 50000 THEN 'high_engagement'
            WHEN COALESCE(saf.feedback_count, 0) >= 50 OR COALESCE(saf.total_session_duration, 0) >= 20000 THEN 'medium_engagement'
            ELSE 'low_engagement'
        END AS engagement_label,
        ROUND(
            1.0 * COALESCE(saf.total_session_duration, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(saf.feedback_count, 0), 0),
            2
        ) AS duration_per_feedback
    FROM applications AS a
    LEFT JOIN session_app_feedback AS saf
        ON a.application_id = saf.application_id
)
SELECT
    application_name,
    session_count,
    feedback_count,
    avg_feedback_rating,
    duration_per_feedback,
    engagement_label
FROM app_summary
ORDER BY duration_per_feedback DESC, feedback_count DESC, application_name

WITH access_scope AS (
  SELECT
    al.access_id,
    al.incident_id,
    al.user_id,
    al.access_date
  FROM access_logs AS al
  WHERE al.access_type = 'view'
    AND al.access_date IS NOT NULL
    AND al.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND al.incident_id IS NOT NULL
    AND al.access_date >= (
      SELECT MIN(access_date)
      FROM access_logs
      WHERE access_date IS NOT NULL
        AND access_type = 'view'
    )
),
user_note_rank AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.user_name,
    COUNT(*) AS confidential_note_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, u.user_id
    ) AS note_rank
  FROM access_scope AS s
  JOIN users AS u
    ON u.user_id = s.user_id
  JOIN incident_notes AS n
    ON n.incident_id = s.incident_id
   AND n.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE n.is_confidential = 1
  GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name
),
survivors AS (
  SELECT
    unr.user_id,
    unr.user_name,
    unr.confidential_note_count,
    COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_view_accesses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT al.incident_id) AS distinct_incidents_viewed
  FROM user_note_rank AS unr
  JOIN access_logs AS al
    ON al.user_id = unr.user_id
   AND al.access_type = 'view'
  WHERE unr.note_rank <= 5
  GROUP BY unr.user_id, unr.user_name, unr.confidential_note_count
)
SELECT
  user_id AS user_id,
  user_name AS user_name,
  confidential_note_count AS confidential_note_count,
  total_view_accesses AS total_view_accesses,
  distinct_incidents_viewed AS distinct_incidents_viewed,
  ROUND(100.0 * confidential_note_count / SUM(confidential_note_count) OVER (), 2) AS confidential_note_share_pct
FROM survivors
ORDER BY confidential_note_share_pct DESC, user_id

WITH material_stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.material_id,
    m.hardness,
    m.condition,
    hs.scale_name AS hardness_scale_name,
    mc.condition_name,
    AVG(CAST(cr.vc_min AS REAL)) AS avg_vc_min,
    COUNT(cr.recommendation_id) AS recommendation_count,
    AVG(CAST(cr.vc_max AS REAL) - CAST(cr.vc_min AS REAL)) AS avg_vc_range,
    MAX(CAST(cr.spindle_speed_max AS REAL)) AS max_spindle_speed_max,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cr.recommendation_id) > 0 THEN 'recommended'
      ELSE 'no_recommendations'
    END AS recommendation_label
  FROM materials AS m
  LEFT JOIN hardness_scale AS hs
    ON m.hardness = hs.hardness_value
  LEFT JOIN material_conditions AS mc
    ON m.condition = mc.condition_id
  LEFT JOIN cutting_recommendations AS cr
    ON m.material_id = cr.material_id
  GROUP BY
    m.material_id,
    m.hardness,
    m.condition,
    hs.scale_name,
    mc.condition_name
)
SELECT
  hardness_scale_name AS hardness_scale_name,
  condition_name AS condition_name,
  COUNT(*) AS material_count,
  AVG(avg_vc_min) AS avg_of_avg_vc_min,
  AVG(recommendation_count) AS avg_recommendation_count,
  MAX(max_spindle_speed_max) AS max_spindle_speed_max,
  AVG(avg_vc_range) AS avg_vc_range,
  recommendation_label AS recommendation_label
FROM material_stats
GROUP BY
  hardness_scale_name,
  condition_name,
  recommendation_label
ORDER BY
  hardness_scale_name,
  condition_name,

WITH lipid_versions AS (

    COUNT(DISTINCT fp.pattern_id) AS pattern_count,

    MAX(v.version_number) AS max_version_number

    ON l.lipid_id = v.lipid_id
  LEFT JOIN fragmentation_patterns AS fp
    ON l.lipid_id = fp.lipid_id
  GROUP BY
    l.lipid_id,
    l.identification,
    l.lipid_class
),
day_span AS (
  SELECT
    lipid_id,
    CASE
      WHEN MIN(version_date) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(version_date) IS NOT NULL
      THEN julianday(MAX(version_date)) - julianday(MIN(version_date)) + 1
      ELSE 1
    END AS active_days
  FROM versions
  GROUP BY lipid_id
)
SELECT
  lv.lipid_id AS lipid_id,
  lv.identification AS lipid_label,
  lv.lipid_class AS lipid_class,
  lv.version_count AS version_count,
  lv.pattern_count AS pattern_count,
  ROUND(CAST(lv.version_count AS REAL) / ds.active_days, 3) AS versions_per_day,
  ROUND(lv.avg_fragment_intensity, 3) AS avg_fragment_intensity,
  lv.max_version_number AS max_version_number
FROM lipid_versions AS lv

  ON lv.lipid_id = ds.lipid_id
ORDER BY versions_per_day DESC, lv.version_count DESC, lv.lipid_id

WITH record_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.artist_id,
    a.artist_name,
    al.album_id,
    al.album_title,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS total_records,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_records,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.price IS NOT NULL AND r.price > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS priced_records,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'active' AND r.price IS NOT NULL AND r.price > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_priced_records
  FROM artists AS a
  LEFT JOIN albums AS al
    ON al.artist_id = a.artist_id
  LEFT JOIN records AS r
    ON r.album_id = al.album_id
  GROUP BY a.artist_id, a.artist_name, al.album_id, al.album_title
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    artist_id,
    artist_name,
    album_id,
    album_title,
    total_records,
    active_records,
    priced_records,
    active_priced_records,
    ROUND(
      1.0 * active_records / NULLIF(priced_records, 0),
      3
    ) AS active_to_priced_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN 1.0 * active_records / NULLIF(priced_records, 0) >= 0.75 THEN 'high'
      WHEN 1.0 * active_records / NULLIF(priced_records, 0) >= 0.40 THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'low'
    END AS ratio_label,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY artist_id
      ORDER BY total_records DESC, album_id
    ) AS album_rank
  FROM record_stats
)
SELECT
  artist_id,
  artist_name,
  album_id,
  album_title,
  total_records,
  active_records,
  priced_records,
  active_priced_records,
  active_to_priced_ratio,
  ratio_label
FROM ranked
WHERE album_rank = 1
ORDER BY active_to_priced_ratio DESC, artist_name, album_title

WITH first_period AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_first_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wi.status = 'completed' THEN o.order_id END) AS completed_orders_first_period,
    SUM(oli.lineitem_total) AS revenue_first_period
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_line_items oli ON o.order_id = oli.order_id
  LEFT JOIN work_items wi ON o.order_id = wi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date < '2023-01-01'
),
second_period AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_second_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wi.status = 'completed' THEN o.order_id END) AS completed_orders_second_period,
    SUM(oli.lineitem_total) AS revenue_second_period
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_line_items oli ON o.order_id = oli.order_id
  LEFT JOIN work_items wi ON o.order_id = wi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
)
SELECT
  (second_period.revenue_second_period - first_period.revenue_first_period) AS revenue_change,
  1.0 * first_period.completed_orders_first_period / first_period.orders_first_period AS completed_order_rate_first_period,
  1.0 * second_period.completed_orders_second_period / (second_period.orders_second_period - 1) AS completed_order_rate_second_period,
  (1.0 * second_period.completed_orders_second_period / (second_period.orders_second_period - 1))
    - (1.0 * first_period.completed_orders_first_period / first_period.orders_first_period) AS completed_order_rate_change
FROM first_period, second_period

WITH pressure_by_well AS (
    SELECT
        pd.well_id,
        COUNT(*) AS pressure_points,
        SUM(pd.flow_rate) AS total_flow_rate,
        AVG(pd."bottom-hole_pressure") AS avg_bottom_hole_pressure,
        MAX(pd.date) AS latest_pressure_date
    FROM pressure_data pd
    WHERE pd.well_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pd.well_id
),
well_type_counts AS (
    SELECT
        w.type_id,
        COUNT(*) AS wells_in_type
    FROM wells w
    WHERE w.type_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY w.type_id
),
type_pressure AS (
    SELECT
        wt.type_id,
        wt.type_name,
        wt.description AS type_description,
        wt.maintenance_frequency,
        COALESCE(SUM(pbw.pressure_points), 0) AS total_pressure_points,
        COALESCE(SUM(pbw.total_flow_rate), 0) AS total_flow_rate,
        COALESCE(AVG(pbw.avg_bottom_hole_pressure), 0) AS avg_bottom_hole_pressure,
        COALESCE(MAX(pbw.latest_pressure_date), '') AS latest_pressure_date,
        COALESCE(wtc.wells_in_type, 0) AS wells_in_type
    FROM well_types wt
    LEFT JOIN wells w
        ON w.type_id = wt.type_id
    LEFT JOIN pressure_by_well pbw
        ON pbw.well_id = w.well_id
    LEFT JOIN well_type_counts wtc
        ON wtc.type_id = wt.type_id
    GROUP BY
        wt.type_id,
        wt.type_name,
        wt.description,
        wt.maintenance_frequency,
        wtc.wells_in_type
),
ranked_types AS (
    SELECT
        tp.*,
        SUM(tp.total_pressure_points) OVER (
            ORDER BY tp.total_pressure_points DESC, tp.type_id
        ) AS running_pressure_points
    FROM type_pressure tp
)
SELECT
    type_id,
    type_name,
    type_description,
    maintenance_frequency,
    wells_in_type,
    total_pressure_points,
    total_flow_rate,
    avg_bottom_hole_pressure,
    latest_pressure_date,
    running_pressure_points
FROM ranked_types
ORDER BY total_pressure_points DESC, type_id

WITH voyage_span AS (

    v.ship_id,

    v.arrival_date,
    julianday(v.arrival_date) - julianday(v.departure_date) AS voyage_duration_days
  FROM voyages AS v
  WHERE v.departure_date IS NOT NULL
    AND v.arrival_date IS NOT NULL
),
class_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.class_id,
    c.class_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.voyage_id) AS voyage_count,
    AVG(ss.survival_rate) AS avg_survival_rate,
    MAX(ss.survival_rate) AS max_survival_rate
  FROM classifications AS c
  LEFT JOIN survival_statistics AS ss
    ON ss.class_id = c.class_id
  GROUP BY c.class_id, c.class_name
)
SELECT
  c.class_id,
  c.class_name AS class_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.stat_id) AS stat_count,
  AVG(ss.total_passengers) AS avg_total_passengers,
  AVG(ss.survivors) AS avg_survivors,
  MAX(vs.voyage_duration_days) AS longest_voyage_span_days,
  MIN(vs.departure_date) AS earliest_departure_timestamp,
  MAX(vs.arrival_date) AS latest_arrival_timestamp,
  (julianday(MAX(vs.arrival_date)) - julianday(MIN(vs.departure_date))) AS headline_time_span_days,
  ROUND(AVG(ss.survival_rate), 4) AS avg_survival_rate,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN ss.survivors IS NOT NULL AND ss.total_passengers IS NOT NULL AND ss.total_passengers <> 0
             THEN ss.survivors * 1.0 / ss.total_passengers
        END) / NULLIF(COUNT(ss.stat_id), 0),
    4
  ) AS survivor_ratio
FROM classifications AS c
LEFT JOIN survival_statistics AS ss

measure: a per-unit rate (per day, per member, per km)

WITH listing_sales AS (
    SELECT
        l.agent_id,
        l.listing_id,
        l.list_price,
        l.list_date,
        s.sale_id,
        s.sale_date,
        s.sale_price,
        CAST(julianday(s.sale_date) - julianday(l.list_date) AS REAL) AS days_on_market,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY l.listing_id
            ORDER BY s.sale_date, s.sale_id
        ) AS sale_rank
    FROM listings AS l
    JOIN sales AS s
        ON s.listing_id = l.listing_id
    WHERE l.list_date IS NOT NULL
      AND s.sale_date IS NOT NULL
      AND julianday(s.sale_date) >= julianday(l.list_date)
),
agent_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        COUNT(*) AS sold_listing_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT listing_id) AS distinct_listings_sold,
        SUM(sale_price) AS total_sale_price,
        SUM(list_price) AS total_list_price,
        AVG(days_on_market) AS avg_days_on_market,
        MIN(days_on_market) AS min_days_on_market,
        MAX(days_on_market) AS max_days_on_market
    FROM listing_sales
    WHERE sale_rank = 1
    GROUP BY agent_id
)
SELECT
    a.agent_id AS agent_id,
    a.name AS agent_name,
    ar.sold_listing_count AS sold_listing_count,
    ROUND(CAST(ar.total_sale_price AS REAL) / NULLIF(ar.avg_days_on_market, 0), 2) AS sale_price_per_day,
    ROUND(CAST(ar.total_list_price AS REAL) / NULLIF(ar.distinct_listings_sold, 0), 2) AS avg_list_price_per_listing,
    ROUND(ar.avg_days_on_market, 2) AS avg_days_on_market,
    ar.min_days_on_market AS min_days_on_market,
    ar.max_days_on_market AS max_days_on_market
FROM agent_rollup AS ar
JOIN agents AS a
    ON a.agent_id = ar.agent_id
ORDER BY sale_price_per_day DESC, sold_listing_count DESC, a.agent_id

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.total_cost
    FROM orders o
    JOIN deliveries d
        ON d.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE d.delivery_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.total_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND o.total_cost > (
          SELECT AVG(o2.total_cost)
          FROM orders o2
          WHERE o2.total_cost IS NOT NULL
      )
),
ranked_order_spend AS (
    SELECT
        eo.order_id,
        eo.total_cost,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_items,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY eo.total_cost DESC) AS spend_rank
    FROM eligible_orders eo
    JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = eo.order_id
    GROUP BY eo.order_id, eo.total_cost
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN spend_rank <= 5 THEN total_items ELSE 0 END) / SUM(total_items),
        2
    ) AS top_5_item_share_pct
FROM ranked_order_spend

WITH priced_listings AS (
  SELECT
    l.listing_id,
    l.agent_id,
    l.property_id,
    l.listing_date,
    l.expiration_date,
    l.listing_price,
    p.price AS property_price,
    a.agent_name,
    julianday(l.expiration_date) - julianday(l.listing_date) AS listing_days,
    (l.listing_price - p.price) AS price_markup
  FROM listings AS l
  JOIN properties AS p
    ON p.property_id = l.property_id
  JOIN agents AS a
    ON a.agent_id = l.agent_id
  WHERE l.listing_date IS NOT NULL
    AND l.expiration_date IS NOT NULL
    AND l.listing_price IS NOT NULL
    AND p.price IS NOT NULL
    AND (l.listing_price - p.price) > 0
    AND (julianday(l.expiration_date) - julianday(l.listing_date)) > 0
),
agent_level AS (
  SELECT
    agent_id,
    agent_name,
    COUNT(*) AS qualifying_listings,
    SUM(price_markup) AS total_markup,
    SUM(listing_days) AS total_listing_days,
    AVG(price_markup / listing_days) AS avg_markup_per_day
  FROM priced_listings
  GROUP BY agent_id, agent_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
ranked_agents AS (
  SELECT
    agent_id,
    agent_name,
    qualifying_listings,
    total_markup,
    total_listing_days,
    avg_markup_per_day,

)

  agent_name AS agent_name,
  qualifying_listings AS qualifying_listings,
  ROUND(total_markup, 2) AS total_markup,
  ROUND(total_listing_days, 2) AS total_listing_days,
  ROUND(total_markup / total_listing_days, 4) AS markup_per_day
FROM ranked_agents
WHERE agent_rank <= 10
ORDER BY markup_per_day DESC, total_markup DESC

WITH timestep_stats AS (

    t.timestep_id,
    t.experiment_id,
    COUNT(a.action_id) AS action_count,

WITH scored_events AS (
  SELECT
    ae.anomaly_event_id,
    ae.severity,
    st.S_t_standard,
    rf.S_t_reward_low_FN_rate,
    rp.S_t_reward_low_FP_rate

  LEFT JOIN S_t_reward_low_FN_rate AS rf

severity_totals AS (
  SELECT
    severity,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(S_t_standard, 0)) AS total_standard_score,
    SUM(COALESCE(S_t_reward_low_FN_rate, 0)) AS total_fn_reward,

overall AS (
