WITH file_periods AS (
  SELECT
    e.experiment_name AS experiment_name,
    CASE
      WHEN df.upload_date < e.start_date THEN 'pre_start'
      WHEN df.upload_date <= date(e.start_date, '+30 day') THEN 'early_period'
      ELSE 'late_period'
    END AS period_bucket,
    AVG(df.file_size) AS avg_file_size,
    COUNT(*) AS file_count
  FROM data_files df
  JOIN experiments e
    ON df.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
  WHERE df.upload_date IS NOT NULL
    AND e.start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.experiment_name, period_bucket
),
param_periods AS (
  SELECT
    e.experiment_name AS experiment_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ep.created_at < e.start_date THEN 'pre_start'
      WHEN ep.created_at <= date(e.start_date, '+30 day') THEN 'early_period'
      ELSE 'late_period'
    END AS period_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS param_count
  FROM experimental_parameters ep
  JOIN experiments e
    ON ep.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
  WHERE ep.created_at IS NOT NULL
    AND e.start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.experiment_name, period_bucket
)
SELECT
  fp.experiment_name AS experiment_name,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN fp.period_bucket = 'late_period' THEN fp.avg_file_size * fp.file_count ELSE 0 END) -
   SUM(CASE WHEN fp.period_bucket = 'early_period' THEN fp.avg_file_size * fp.file_count ELSE 0 END)) AS file_size_change,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN pp.period_bucket = 'late_period' THEN pp.param_count ELSE 0 END) -

WITH bug_scope AS (
    SELECT
        b.bug_id,
        b.created_date,
        b.last_updated_date,
        COUNT(bh.history_id) AS history_change_count,
        COUNT(bc.comment_id) AS comment_count
    FROM bugs AS b
    LEFT JOIN bug_history AS bh
        ON bh.bug_id = b.bug_id
       AND bh.field_name = 'status'
    LEFT JOIN bug_comments AS bc
        ON bc.bug_id = b.bug_id
    GROUP BY b.bug_id, b.created_date, b.last_updated_date
    HAVING COUNT(bh.history_id) >= 2
       AND COUNT(bc.comment_id) >= 1
),
ranked_bugs AS (
    SELECT
        bug_id,
        created_date,
        last_updated_date,
        history_change_count,
        comment_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY history_change_count DESC, comment_count DESC, bug_id
        ) AS bug_rank
    FROM bug_scope
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        bug_id,
        created_date,
        last_updated_date,
        history_change_count,

WITH target_authors AS (

  FROM authors a
  JOIN commits c

author_commit_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) AS active_notified_authors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT commit_id) AS notified_commits
  FROM (

     AND n.commit_id = c.commit_id
  )
)
SELECT
  active_notified_authors,
  notified_commits,
  100.0 * notified_commits / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commits WHERE author_id IN (SELECT author_id FROM target_authors)), 0) AS notified_commit_percentage
FROM author_commit_stats

WITH filtered_tests AS (
    SELECT
        tr.test_id,
        tr.test_environment_id,
        tr.num_failures,
        tr.num_tests
    FROM test_results tr
    JOIN environments e
        ON e.environment_id = tr.test_environment_id
    WHERE e.environment_status = 'active'
      AND tr.num_failures > (
          SELECT AVG(tr2.num_failures)
          FROM test_results tr2
          WHERE tr2.test_environment_id = tr.test_environment_id
      )

ranked_tests AS (
    SELECT
        ft.test_id,
        ft.test_environment_id,
        ft.num_failures,
        ft.num_tests,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ft.test_environment_id
            ORDER BY ft.num_failures DESC, ft.test_id
        ) AS failure_rank
    FROM filtered_tests ft
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        rt.test_environment_id,
        rt.num_failures
    FROM ranked_tests rt
    WHERE rt.failure_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    e.environment_name AS environment_name,
    SUM(s.num_failures) AS top_failure_count,
    COUNT(*) AS top_test_count,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(s.num_failures) / SUM(SUM(s.num_failures)) OVER (),
        4
    ) AS failure_share_of_total
FROM survivors s
JOIN environments e
    ON e.environment_id = s.test_environment_id
GROUP BY e.environment_name
ORDER BY failure_share_of_total DESC, top_failure_count DESC

base AS (

    jc.total_judges,

WITH user_bet_span AS (

    b.bet_count,

WITH match_sets AS (

    ON r.match_id = m.match_id
  GROUP BY m.match_id, m.match_date
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_date < '2024-01-01' THEN prediction_types ELSE 0 END) AS preds_before_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN prediction_types ELSE 0 END) AS preds_from_2024,

WITH dataset_scope AS (

    d.dataset_id,

    COUNT(DISTINCT r.report_id) AS report_count

    ON db.dataset_id = d.dataset_id
  LEFT JOIN reports AS r
    ON r.dataset_id = d.dataset_id
  GROUP BY d.dataset_id, d.dataset_name, d.data_quality_score
),
selected_datasets AS (
  SELECT
    dataset_id,
    dataset_name,
    data_quality_score,
    dashboard_count,
    report_count,
    (dashboard_count + report_count) AS activity_score
  FROM dataset_scope

FROM ranked_datasets

ORDER BY dataset_count DESC, activity_label

WITH student_waivers AS (
  SELECT
    s.student_id,
    s.student_name,
    d.department_name,
    MIN(fw.approval_date) AS first_approval_date,
    MAX(fw.waiver_expiration_date) AS last_expiration_date,
    COUNT(fw.waiver_id) AS waiver_count
  FROM students s
  JOIN departments d
    ON d.department_id = s.department_id
  LEFT JOIN fee_waivers fw
    ON fw.student_id = s.student_id
   AND fw.status = 'approved'
  GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, d.department_name
),
department_rates AS (
  SELECT
    department_name,
    AVG(julianday(last_expiration_date) - julianday(first_approval_date)) AS avg_waiver_span_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN waiver_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS students_with_approved_waivers,
    COUNT(*) AS total_students
  FROM student_waivers
  GROUP BY department_name
)
SELECT
  department_name,
  avg_waiver_span_days AS avg_span_between_approval_and_expiration_days,
  students_with_approved_waivers * 1.0 / (total_students - 1) AS waiver_coverage_rate_excluding_one_student
FROM department_rates
WHERE total_students > 1
ORDER BY avg_span_between_approval_and_expiration_days DESC

gold_sql:
WITH user_access_span AS (
  SELECT
    al.user_id,
    MIN(al.access_date) AS first_access_ts,
    MAX(al.access_date) AS last_access_ts,
    COUNT(*) AS total_accesses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT al.university_id) AS distinct_universities_accessed,
    AVG(al.duration) AS avg_access_duration,
    MAX(al.duration) AS max_access_duration
  FROM access_logs al
  WHERE al.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND al.access_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY al.user_id
),
university_access_span AS (
  SELECT
    al.university_id,
    MIN(al.access_date) AS first_access_ts,
    MAX(al.access_date) AS last_access_ts,
    COUNT(*) AS total_accesses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT al.user_id) AS distinct_users,
    AVG(al.duration) AS avg_access_duration,
    MAX(al.duration) AS max_access_duration
  FROM access_logs al
  WHERE al.university_id IS NOT NULL
    AND al.access_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY al.university_id
)
SELECT
  u.university_id AS university_id,
  u.university_name AS university_name,
  uas.first_access_ts AS first_access_ts,
  uas.last_access_ts AS last_access_ts,
  (julianday(uas.last_access_ts) - julianday(uas.first_access_ts)) AS access_span_days,
  uas.total_accesses AS total_accesses,
  uas.distinct_users AS distinct_users,
  ROUND(CAST(uas.distinct_users AS REAL) / NULLIF(uas.total_accesses, 0), 3) AS user_to_access_ratio,
  ROUND(uas.avg_access_duration, 2) AS avg_access_duration_seconds,
  uas.max_access_duration AS max_access_duration_seconds,
  CASE
    WHEN u.type IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
    ELSE u.type
  END AS university_type_label
FROM university_access_span uas
JOIN universities u
  ON u.university_id = uas.university_id
ORDER BY access_span_days DESC, total_accesses DESC, university_name

WITH pop_by_area AS (
  SELECT
    urban_area_id,
    SUM(population) AS total_population
  FROM population_data
  GROUP BY urban_area_id
),
metric_by_area AS (
  SELECT
    urban_area_id,
    AVG(median_age) AS avg_median_age,
    AVG(average_income) AS avg_average_income
  FROM demographic_metrics
  GROUP BY urban_area_id
)
SELECT
  ua.name AS urban_area_name,
  p.total_population AS total_population,
  m.avg_median_age AS avg_median_age,
  m.avg_average_income AS avg_average_income,
  (m.avg_average_income / p.total_population) AS income_per_person,
  CASE
    WHEN (m.avg_average_income / p.total_population) >= 20 THEN 'very_high'
    WHEN (m.avg_average_income / p.total_population) >= 10 THEN 'high'
    WHEN (m.avg_average_income / p.total_population) >= 5 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS income_density_label
FROM urban_areas ua
JOIN pop_by_area p
  ON ua.urban_area_id = p.urban_area_id
JOIN metric_by_area m
  ON ua.urban_area_id = m.urban_area_id
ORDER BY income_per_person DESC, ua.name
LIMIT 10

WITH role_permission_counts AS (
  SELECT

    r.role_name,

  FROM roles r

),
role_time_span AS (
  SELECT
    u.role_id,
    MIN(u.created_at) AS first_created_at,
    MAX(u.updated_at) AS last_updated_at,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
  FROM users u
  WHERE u.created_at IS NOT NULL
    AND u.updated_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY u.role_id
)
SELECT
  r.role_id AS role_id,
  r.role_name AS role_name,
  rpc.permission_count AS permission_count,
  rts.user_count AS user_count,
  rts.first_created_at AS first_created_at,
  rts.last_updated_at AS last_updated_at,
  ROUND((julianday(rts.last_updated_at) - julianday(rts.first_created_at)) * 24 * 60, 2) AS active_span_minutes

WITH course_quality AS (
  SELECT
    c.course_id,
    c.subject,
    c.course_number,
    c.campus,
    c.year,
    c.session,
    AVG(e.avg_grade) AS avg_course_grade,
    SUM(e.enrolled) AS total_enrolled,
    AVG(
      COALESCE(g.less_than_50, 0) + COALESCE(g.between_50_54, 0) + COALESCE(g.between_55_59, 0) +
      COALESCE(g.between_60_63, 0) + COALESCE(g.between_64_67, 0) + COALESCE(g.between_68_71, 0) +
      COALESCE(g.between_72_75, 0) + COALESCE(g.between_76_79, 0) + COALESCE(g.between_80_84, 0) +
      COALESCE(g.between_85_89, 0) + COALESCE(g.between_90_100, 0)
    ) AS avg_grade_distribution_total
  FROM courses AS c
  JOIN enrollment AS e
    ON e.course_id = c.course_id
  JOIN grade_distributions AS g
    ON g.course_id = c.course_id
  GROUP BY c.course_id, c.subject, c.course_number, c.campus, c.year, c.session
),
filtered_courses AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    (avg_course_grade - avg_grade_distribution_total / 1000.0) AS quality_gap
  FROM course_quality

),
ranked_courses AS (
  SELECT
    course_id,
    subject,
    course_number,
    campus,
    year,

    avg_course_grade,
    total_enrolled,
    avg_grade_distribution_total,
    quality_gap,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY quality_gap DESC, total_enrolled DESC, course_id) AS quality_rank

running_totals AS (

    total_enrolled,
    avg_grade_distribution_total,

  FROM ranked_courses

SELECT

WITH station_forecast_span AS (

WITH alert_base AS (
    SELECT
        ea.alert_id,
        ea.event_id,
        ea.vehicle_id,
        ea.alert_type,
        ea.alert_status,
        e.priority,
        v.status AS vehicle_status,
        CAST(LENGTH(COALESCE(ea.alert_message, '')) AS REAL) AS message_length,
        CAST(COALESCE(e.priority, 0) AS REAL) AS priority_value
    FROM event_alerts ea
    LEFT JOIN events e
        ON ea.event_id = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN vehicles v
        ON ea.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
    WHERE ea.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND ea.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL
),
vehicle_alert_stats AS (
    SELECT
        vehicle_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_alerts,
        AVG(message_length) AS avg_message_length_all,
        AVG(CASE WHEN alert_status = 'active' THEN message_length END) AS avg_message_length_active,
        AVG(priority_value) AS avg_priority_all,
        AVG(CASE WHEN vehicle_status = 'active' THEN priority_value END) AS avg_priority_for_active_vehicles
    FROM alert_base
    GROUP BY vehicle_id
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(avg_message_length_all) AS overall_avg_message_length_all,
        AVG(avg_message_length_active) AS overall_avg_message_length_active,
        AVG(avg_priority_all) AS overall_avg_priority_all,
        AVG(avg_priority_for_active_vehicles) AS overall_avg_priority_for_active_vehicles,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN avg_message_length_all > 0
                THEN avg_message_length_active / avg_message_length_all
            END
        ) AS avg_active_to_all_message_length_ratio
    FROM vehicle_alert_stats
)
SELECT
    vehicle_id,
    total_alerts,
    ROUND(avg_message_length_all, 2) AS avg_message_length_all,
    ROUND(avg_message_length_active, 2) AS avg_message_length_active,
    ROUND(avg_priority_all, 2) AS avg_priority_all,
    ROUND(avg_priority_for_active_vehicles, 2) AS avg_priority_for_active_vehicles,
    ROUND(
        avg_message_length_active / NULLIF(avg_message_length_all, 0),
        4
    ) AS active_to_all_message_length_ratio,
    ROUND(
        avg_priority_for_active_vehicles / NULLIF(avg_priority_all, 0),

gold_sql:
WITH flight_delay_summary AS (
  SELECT
    f.flight_id,
    f.flight_number,
    f.scheduled_time,
    COUNT(fd.delay_id) AS delay_count,
    AVG(fd.delay_duration) AS avg_delay_duration,
    MAX(fd.delay_duration) AS max_delay_duration,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(fd.delay_id) = 0 THEN 'no_delays'
      WHEN AVG(fd.delay_duration) >= 1800 THEN 'severe_delay'
      ELSE 'moderate_delay'
    END AS delay_label
  FROM flights AS f
  LEFT JOIN flight_delays AS fd
    ON f.flight_id = fd.flight_id
  GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.flight_number, f.scheduled_time
),
boarding_summary AS (
  SELECT
    bp.flight_id,
    COUNT(bp.boarding_pass_id) AS boarding_pass_count
  FROM boarding_passes AS bp
  GROUP BY bp.flight_id
)
SELECT
  fds.flight_id,
  fds.flight_number,
  fds.delay_count,
  COALESCE(bs.boarding_pass_count, 0) AS boarding_pass_count,
  ROUND(1.0 * fds.delay_count / NULLIF(COALESCE(bs.boarding_pass_count, 0), 0), 3) AS delay_to_boarding_ratio,
  fds.avg_delay_duration,
  fds.max_delay_duration,
  fds.delay_label,
  SUM(fds.delay_count) OVER (
    ORDER BY fds.scheduled_time, fds.flight_id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_delay_count
FROM flight_delay_summary AS fds
LEFT JOIN boarding_summary AS bs
  ON fds.flight_id = bs.flight_id
ORDER BY fds.scheduled_time, fds.flight_id

WITH crew_span AS (

      AND fc.end_date IS NOT NULL

WITH active_users AS (
  SELECT
    user_id
  FROM users
  WHERE is_active = 1
),
user_access_counts AS (
  SELECT
    al.user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS access_count
  FROM access_logs al
  JOIN active_users au
    ON al.user_id = au.user_id
  WHERE al.access_date IS NOT NULL
    AND al.access_type = 'view'
  GROUP BY al.user_id
),
qualified_users AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    access_count
  FROM user_access_counts
  WHERE access_count >= 5
),
qualified_user_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS qualifying_user_count,
    SUM(access_count) AS total_view_accesses,
    MIN(access_count) AS min_accesses_per_user,
    MAX(access_count) AS max_accesses_per_user,
    AVG(access_count) AS avg_accesses_per_user
  FROM qualified_users
),
date_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(access_date) AS first_access_date,
    MAX(access_date) AS last_access_date
  FROM access_logs
  WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM qualified_users)
    AND access_date IS NOT NULL
),
rate_stats AS (
  SELECT
    qus.qualifying_user_count,
    qus.total_view_accesses,
    qus.min_accesses_per_user,
    qus.max_accesses_per_user,
    qus.avg_accesses_per_user,
    CAST(julianday(db.last_access_date) - julianday(db.first_access_date) + 1 AS REAL) AS active_day_span,
    CASE
      WHEN (julianday(db.last_access_date) - julianday(db.first_access_date) + 1) > 0
      THEN qus.total_view_accesses * 1.0 / (julianday(db.last_access_date) - julianday(db.first_access_date) + 1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS view_accesses_per_day
  FROM qualified_user_stats qus
  CROSS JOIN date_bounds db
)
SELECT
  qualifying_user_count,
  total_view_accesses,
  active_day_span,
  view_accesses_per_day,
  avg_accesses_per_user
FROM rate_stats

WITH spec_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.component_id,
        c.name AS component_name,
        c.type AS component_type,
        c.component_status AS component_status,
        COUNT(cs.spec_id) AS spec_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.parameter) AS distinct_spec_parameters
    FROM components c
    LEFT JOIN component_specs cs
        ON c.component_id = cs.component_id
    GROUP BY
        c.component_id,
        c.name,
        c.type,
        c.component_status
),
terminal_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.component_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tc.terminal_id) AS terminal_count
    FROM components c
    LEFT JOIN terminal_connections tc
        ON c.component_id = tc.component_id
    GROUP BY
        c.component_id
),
joined_counts AS (
    SELECT
        sc.component_id,
        sc.component_name,
        sc.component_type,
        sc.component_status,
        sc.spec_count,
        sc.distinct_spec_parameters,
        COALESCE(tn.terminal_count, 0) AS terminal_count
    FROM spec_counts sc
    LEFT JOIN terminal_counts tn
        ON sc.component_id = tn.component_id
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(spec_count) AS total_spec_count,
        SUM(terminal_count) AS total_terminal_count
    FROM joined_counts
)
SELECT
    jc.component_id,
    jc.component_name,
    jc.component_type,
    jc.component_status,
    jc.spec_count,
    jc.terminal_count,
    ROUND(jc.spec_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.total_spec_count, 0), 4) AS spec_share_of_total,
    ROUND(jc.terminal_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.total_terminal_count, 0), 4) AS terminal_share_of_total,
    ROUND(jc.spec_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(jc.spec_count) OVER (), 0), 4) AS spec_share_window
FROM joined_counts jc
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY jc.spec_count DESC, jc.component_id

WITH monthly_access AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', access_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_accesses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN access_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_accesses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users,
    SUM(CASE WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT engineer_id FROM test_engineers) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_engineer_user_accesses
  FROM access_logs
  WHERE access_date IS NOT NULL
    AND access_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', access_date)
),
monthly_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', pm.test_version) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS metric_rows,
    AVG(metric_value) AS avg_metric_value
  FROM performance_metrics pm
  WHERE pm.test_version IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', pm.test_version)
),
ordered_months AS (
  SELECT
    m.month,
    m.total_accesses,
    m.view_accesses,
    m.active_users,
    m.non_engineer_user_accesses,
    COALESCE(mt.metric_rows, 0) AS metric_rows,
    COALESCE(mt.avg_metric_value, 0.0) AS avg_metric_value,
    LAG(m.total_accesses) OVER (ORDER BY m.month) AS prev_total_accesses,
    LAG(m.view_accesses) OVER (ORDER BY m.month) AS prev_view_accesses
  FROM monthly_access m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_metrics mt
    ON mt.month = m.month
)
SELECT
  month AS month,
  total_accesses AS total_accesses,
  ROUND(view_accesses * 1.0 / total_accesses, 4) AS view_rate,
  ROUND(non_engineer_user_accesses * 1.0 / total_accesses, 4) AS non_engineer_access_rate,
  ROUND((total_accesses - COALESCE(prev_total_accesses, total_accesses)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(prev_total_accesses, total_accesses), 0), 4) AS access_change_rate,
  ROUND((view_accesses - COALESCE(prev_view_accesses, view_accesses)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(prev_view_accesses, view_accesses), 0), 4) AS view_change_rate,
  metric_rows AS metric_rows,
  ROUND(avg_metric_value, 3) AS avg_metric_value
FROM ordered_months
ORDER BY month

    st1.avg_points AS current_avg_points,
    st1.max_points AS current_max_points,
    st1.min_points AS current_min_points
  FROM season_team st1
  JOIN season_team st2

JOIN teams t

JOIN seasons s1

WITH terpene_totals AS (
  SELECT
    tp.variant_id AS variant_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_terpene_rows
  FROM variant_terpene_profile tp
  GROUP BY tp.variant_id
),
variant_matches AS (
  SELECT
    v.variant_id AS variant_id,
    v.variant_name AS variant_name,
    COUNT(tp.profile_id) AS matched_terpene_rows
  FROM strain_variants v
  LEFT JOIN variant_terpene_profile tp
    ON v.variant_id = tp.variant_id
   AND tp.concentration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY v.variant_id, v.variant_name
)
SELECT
  vm.variant_name AS variant_name,
  vm.matched_terpene_rows AS matched_terpene_rows,
  COALESCE(tt.total_terpene_rows, 0) AS total_terpene_rows,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(tt.total_terpene_rows, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 1.0 * vm.matched_terpene_rows / tt.total_terpene_rows
  END AS share_of_terpene_rows_with_concentration
FROM variant_matches vm

  ON vm.variant_id = tt.variant_id

WITH size_totals AS (

    SUM(active_measurement_value) OVER (

)

store_customer_summary AS (

 AND cs.is_active = 1

WITH balance_stats AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS balance_count,
    AVG(amount) AS avg_balance_amount,
    MAX(amount) AS max_balance_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS balance_nonnull_ratio
  FROM user_balances

trade_stats AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trade_event_count,
    AVG(trade_fee) AS avg_trade_fee,

  FROM trade_history

SELECT
  u.user_id AS user_id,
  u.username AS username,
  COALESCE(ts.trade_event_count, 0) AS trade_event_count,
  COALESCE(bs.balance_count, 0) AS balance_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ts.trade_event_count, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(bs.balance_count, 0), 0), 3) AS trade_to_balance_ratio,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ts.avg_trade_fee, 0), 6) AS avg_trade_fee,
  ROUND(COALESCE(bs.avg_balance_amount, 0), 6) AS avg_balance_amount,
  ROUND(COALESCE(bs.max_balance_amount, 0), 6) AS max_balance_amount,

FROM users AS u
LEFT JOIN trade_stats AS ts
  ON u.user_id = ts.user_id
LEFT JOIN balance_stats AS bs
  ON u.user_id = bs.user_id
ORDER BY trade_event_count DESC, user_id

WITH source_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ds.source_id,
        ds.source_name,
        ds.source_url,
        COUNT(dsl.link_id) AS linked_data_count,
        SUM(dd.population_total) AS linked_population_total

    JOIN data_source_links AS dsl
        ON ds.source_id = dsl.source_id
    JOIN demographic_data AS dd
        ON dsl.data_id = dd.data_id
    WHERE dd.diversity_index > (
        SELECT AVG(diversity_index)
        FROM demographic_data
        WHERE diversity_index IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY ds.source_id, ds.source_name, ds.source_url
),
ranked_sources AS (
    SELECT
        source_id,
        source_name,
        source_url,
        linked_data_count,
        linked_population_total,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY linked_population_total DESC) AS population_rank
    FROM source_totals
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        source_id,
        source_name,
        source_url,
        linked_data_count,
        linked_population_total
    FROM ranked_sources
    WHERE population_rank <= 5
)
SELECT
    source_id AS source_id,

    source_url AS source_url,
    linked_data_count AS linked_data_count,
    linked_population_total AS linked_population_total,
    ROUND(

FROM survivors
ORDER BY linked_population_total DESC, source_id

WITH player_match AS (
  SELECT
    p.team_id,
    ps.match_id,
    m.year,
    SUM(ps.goals_scored) AS total_goals,
    SUM(ps.assists) AS total_assists
  FROM player_statistics AS ps
  JOIN players AS p
    ON ps.player_id = p.player_id
  JOIN matches AS m
    ON ps.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE ps.match_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.year IS NOT NULL
    AND p.team_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.team_id, ps.match_id, m.year
),
qualified_teams AS (
  SELECT
    team_id
  FROM player_match
  GROUP BY team_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN year < 2015 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN year >= 2015 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT
    pm.team_id,
    t.team_name,
    CASE WHEN pm.year < 2015 THEN 'early' ELSE 'late' END AS period_name,
    SUM(pm.total_goals) AS period_goals,
    SUM(pm.total_assists) AS period_assists
  FROM player_match AS pm
  JOIN qualified_teams AS qt
    ON pm.team_id = qt.team_id
  JOIN teams AS t
    ON pm.team_id = t.team_id
  GROUP BY pm.team_id, t.team_name, period_name
),
team_changes AS (
  SELECT
    team_id,
    team_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period_name = 'early' THEN period_goals END) AS early_goals,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period_name = 'late' THEN period_goals END) AS late_goals,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period_name = 'early' THEN period_assists END) AS early_assists,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period_name = 'late' THEN period_assists END) AS late_assists
  FROM period_totals
  GROUP BY team_id, team_name
)
SELECT
  team_name,
  early_goals,
  late_goals,
  late_goals - early_goals AS goals_change,
  late_assists - early_assists AS assists_change
FROM team_changes
ORDER BY goals_change DESC, team_name ASC

WITH filtered_feeds AS (
    SELECT
        df.feed_id,
        df.indicator_id,
        mi.name AS indicator_name,
        mi.source_id,
        COUNT(mp.prediction_id) AS prediction_count,
        AVG(CAST(mp.predicted_value AS REAL)) AS avg_predicted_value
    FROM data_feeds AS df
    JOIN market_indicators AS mi
        ON df.indicator_id = mi.indicator_id
    JOIN model_predictions AS mp
        ON mp.indicator_id = df.indicator_id
    WHERE df.status = 'active'
      AND df.frequency = 'daily'
      AND mi.source_id = df.source_id
      AND CAST(mp.predicted_value AS REAL) > (
          SELECT AVG(CAST(predicted_value AS REAL))
          FROM model_predictions
          WHERE indicator_id = df.indicator_id
            AND predicted_value IS NOT NULL
      )
    GROUP BY df.feed_id, df.indicator_id, mi.name, mi.source_id
),
ranked_feeds AS (
    SELECT
        feed_id,
        indicator_id,
        indicator_name,
        source_id,
        prediction_count,
        avg_predicted_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY prediction_count DESC, avg_predicted_value DESC, feed_id
        ) AS feed_rank
    FROM filtered_feeds
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        feed_id,
        indicator_id,
        indicator_name,
        source_id,
        prediction_count,
        avg_predicted_value,
        feed_rank
    FROM ranked_feeds
    WHERE feed_rank <= 10
)
SELECT
    feed_id,
    indicator_name,
    prediction_count,
    avg_predicted_value,
    SUM(prediction_count) OVER (

WITH assignment_stats AS (

WITH monthly_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    g.product_line_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', i.last_updated) AS update_month,
    SUM(i.stock_quantity) AS total_stock,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.capacity > 0 THEN i.stock_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS in_capacity_stock
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN garments g ON i.garment_id = g.garment_id
  JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.location_id
  WHERE i.last_updated IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY g.product_line_id, strftime('%Y-%m', i.last_updated)
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT
    product_line_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN update_month BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN total_stock ELSE 0 END) AS stock_h1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN update_month BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-12' THEN total_stock ELSE 0 END) AS stock_h2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN update_month BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN in_capacity_stock ELSE 0 END) AS capacity_stock_h1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN update_month BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-12' THEN in_capacity_stock ELSE 0 END) AS capacity_stock_h2
  FROM monthly_inventory
  GROUP BY product_line_id
)
SELECT
  pl.product_line_name AS product_line_name,
  (pt.stock_h2 - pt.stock_h1) AS stock_change,
  ROUND(1.0 * pt.capacity_stock_h2 / NULLIF(pt.stock_h2, 0), 4) AS h2_capacity_stock_rate,
  ROUND(1.0 * pt.capacity_stock_h1 / NULLIF(pt.stock_h1, 0), 4) AS h1_capacity_stock_rate,
  ROUND(
    (1.0 * pt.capacity_stock_h2 / NULLIF(pt.stock_h2, 0)) -
    (1.0 * pt.capacity_stock_h1 / NULLIF(pt.stock_h1, 0)),
    4
  ) AS capacity_stock_rate_change
FROM period_totals pt
JOIN product_lines pl ON pt.product_line_id = pl.product_line_id
ORDER BY capacity_stock_rate_change DESC, stock_change DESC

WITH download_spans AS (
  SELECT

    MIN(d.download_date) AS first_download_date,

  LEFT JOIN lmic_deciles l

FROM download_spans
ORDER BY download_span_days DESC

WITH selected_years AS (
  SELECT
    y.year_id,
    y.year_name,
    y.gdp_growth_rate,
    y.inflation_rate,
    y.unemployment_rate,
    SUM(ei.value) OVER (
      ORDER BY y.year_name
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_indicator_value
  FROM years y
  JOIN economic_indicators ei
    ON ei.year_id = y.year_id
  WHERE y.year_name BETWEEN '1976' AND '2025'
    AND ei.indicator_type IN ('GDP', 'Inflation Rate')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fiscal_policies fp
      WHERE fp.year_id = y.year_id
        AND fp.policy_impact_factor >= 1.0
    )
),
year_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT year_id) AS selected_year_count,
    MIN(cumulative_indicator_value) AS min_cumulative_indicator_value,
    MAX(cumulative_indicator_value) AS max_cumulative_indicator_value,
    AVG(cumulative_indicator_value) AS avg_cumulative_indicator_value,
    SUM(cumulative_indicator_value) AS total_cumulative_indicator_value
  FROM selected_years
)
SELECT
  selected_year_count,
  min_cumulative_indicator_value,
  max_cumulative_indicator_value,
  avg_cumulative_indicator_value,
  total_cumulative_indicator_value
FROM year_rollup

WITH eligible_patients AS (

    p.gender
  FROM patients p

),
condition_change AS (
  SELECT
    ep.patient_id,
    ep.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN mc.diagnosis_date < '2023-01-01' THEN mc.condition_name
    END) AS pre_2023_conditions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN mc.diagnosis_date >= '2023-01-01' THEN mc.condition_name

ranked_patients AS (

  FROM condition_change
)
SELECT

  MAX(condition_change) AS max_condition_change,

FROM ranked_patients
WHERE rn <= 5
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY avg_condition_change DESC

WITH player_set AS (
  SELECT
    l.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    l.tournament_id,
    l.total_score,
    l.current_round,
    COUNT(s.score_id) AS score_count,
    AVG(s.score) AS avg_round_score,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.round_id IN (
            SELECT r.round_id
            FROM rounds r
            WHERE r.tournament_id = l.tournament_id
              AND r.round_number <= 2
          ) THEN s.score
          ELSE NULL
        END) AS early_score_sum,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.round_id IN (
            SELECT r.round_id
            FROM rounds r
            WHERE r.tournament_id = l.tournament_id
              AND r.round_number > 2
          ) THEN s.score
          ELSE NULL
        END) AS late_score_sum
  FROM leaderboard l
  JOIN players p
    ON p.player_id = l.player_id
  LEFT JOIN scores s
    ON s.player_id = l.player_id
  WHERE l.player_id IS NOT NULL
    AND l.total_score IS NOT NULL
    AND l.total_score < (
      SELECT AVG(l2.total_score)
      FROM leaderboard l2
      WHERE l2.tournament_id = l.tournament_id
        AND l2.total_score IS NOT NULL
    )
  GROUP BY l.player_id, p.player_name, l.tournament_id, l.total_score, l.current_round
),
ranked_players AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    player_name,
    tournament_id,
    total_score,
    current_round,
    score_count,
    avg_round_score,
    early_score_sum,
    late_score_sum,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY tournament_id
      ORDER BY total_score ASC, score_count DESC
    ) AS score_rank
  FROM player_set
),
final_totals AS (
  SELECT
    tournament_id,
    COUNT(*) AS qualified_players,
    SUM(score_count) AS total_scores_counted,
    AVG(avg_round_score) AS mean_avg_round_score,
    AVG(late_score_sum - early_score_sum) AS avg_score_change,
    MAX(late_score_sum - early_score_sum) AS max_score_change
  FROM ranked_players
  WHERE score_rank <= 5
  GROUP BY tournament_id
)
SELECT
  tournament_id AS tournament_id,
  qualified_players AS qualified_players,
  total_scores_counted AS total_scores_counted,
  mean_avg_round_score AS mean_avg_round_score,
  avg_score_change AS avg_score_change,
  max_score_change AS max_score_change
FROM final_totals
ORDER BY avg_score_change DESC, tournament_id ASC

gold_sql:
WITH airport_log_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.airport_id,
    a.name AS airport_name,
    COUNT(al.access_id) AS total_accesses,
    COUNT(al.access_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(na.nav_aid_id), 0) AS access_per_nav_aid,
    AVG(
      julianday(al.access_date) - julianday(
        (SELECT MAX(na2.last_inspection_date)
         FROM navigation_aids na2
         WHERE na2.airport_id = a.airport_id)
      )
    ) AS avg_days_since_nav_aid_inspection
  FROM airports a
  LEFT JOIN access_logs al
    ON al.airport_id = a.airport_id
  LEFT JOIN navigation_aids na
    ON na.airport_id = a.airport_id
   AND na.maintenance_status = 'up to date'
  GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name
)
SELECT
  airport_name,
  total_accesses,
  access_per_nav_aid,
  avg_days_since_nav_aid_inspection
FROM airport_log_stats
ORDER BY access_per_nav_aid DESC, total_accesses DESC
LIMIT 5
